chapters.title: Chapter 2701 Level 3 Black Zone(2)
paragraphs: "You just said it's too risky, but you're still somehow contemplating going to the Level 3 Black Zone?" Mei Feng said when Supreme General Tian remained quiet even several moments later.
"Why don't we just let him go there alone? It's not like we need to monitor him everywhere he goes."

Supreme General Tian finally spoke. "No, we don't. However, that only applies while he's inside the city. The Level 3 Black Zone is an entirely different matter. If he's going to reveal any of his secrets, that's exactly the kind of place where it would happen."
He continued, "I'm aware of the risks, but if someone has to go, it should be me. It simply makes the most sense."

"How does that make any sense?" Mei Feng frowned. "You're the Supreme General. In terms of importance, your safety and presence far outweigh General Gu's and mine, not to mention that member of the Midnight Squad."
Supreme General Tian shook his head before explaining his reasoning.

"I may be the Supreme General, but I was already preparing to retire. Besides, I've lived more than long enough. You, on the other hand, are still young, and you may even take my place in the near future."
"Also, let's not make it seem like I am guaranteed to die out there. It may be dangerous, but as long as I stay alert, I can even survive the Level 4 Black Zone."
Knowing Supreme General Tian's character, Mei Feng understood that trying to change his mind would be pointless now that he had already made his decision.
"Alright..." she eventually said with a reluctant nod.
A few days later, Yuan was summoned to Mei Feng's office.

"The Supreme General has approved your request to enter the Level 3 Black Zone. However, since it's considered the most dangerous area in the world, only a handful of people are even qualified to accompany you. Because of that, the Supreme General has decided to personally observe you this time."
Yuan raised an eyebrow upon hearing this, as he hadn't expected the Supreme General himself to accompany him.
"The most dangerous? I thought there was a Level 4 Black Zone."

"Technically, yes, the Level 4 Black Zone is the most dangerous. But it's so deadly that the longest anyone has ever managed to survive inside is a single week, so we tend to pretend it doesn't even exist."
Yuan nodded.
"When can I leave?" he then asked.
"In eight days. The Supreme General has some work to do before he can leave. Also, you'll only be allowed to train for three months at a time."
"Sounds good."
"I know I don't have to say this, but stay safe."
"I will."
Meanwhile, the Supreme General notified a certain woman of his plans.
"You'll be going to the Level 3 Black Zone? You're not young anymore, Supreme General," Yu Rou remarked after learning of his mission.
"It's not like I enjoy babysitting either, but someone has to keep an eye on that otherworldly brat," Supreme General Tian sighed.

"That being said, I'm actually a little excited to see him in action firsthand—especially since only a handful of people are capable of defeating the Void Specters there, and most of them are dead now..."
After leaving Mei Feng's office, Yuan made his way to the cafeteria, where he had already decided to spend the next several days.
Fortunately for him, the menu changed every week, giving him an entirely new selection of food to enjoy.
On his way to the cafeteria, Yuan encountered Mei Xiaoyun.
"Hey, our squad has three members now," Yuan said to her.
"I haven't been able to find Li Jieyu," Mei Xiaoyun said, shaking her head.

"Oh, that's fine. I already invited her when I bumped into her. Also, I'd like to apologize for not accepting Huang Zhi Han into our squad sooner. It ended up causing unnecessary friction between the two of you..."
Mei Xiaoyun shrugged. "It's fine. To be frank, it was a bit entertaining..."
"Entertaining...?" Yuan raised an eyebrow.
Mei Xiaoyun nodded with a mysterious smile.
"Anyway... once we have four members, I'll bring you guys out on a mission," Yuan said a moment later.
"Take your time."
"Also, I'll be gone for three months in a week for training."
"Where to?"
"Level 3 Black Zone."
"Huh?" Mei Xiaoyun's eyes widened in disbelief, her jaw dropping slightly.
"Didn't you just come back from training at Level 2 Black Zone?"
"I did, and it wasn't challenging enough."
"Not challenging enough? Nobody has traveled to that place in over fifty years because it has gotten more dangerous than before.
"Oh? Is that so? I can't wait." Yuan's anticipation went up the moment he heard that.
"Well, knowing you, there's no point in worrying, so good luck."
Yuan chuckled and said, "Thanks."
After that, Yuan went to the cafeteria to stuff his face, and he repeated it for the next several days.
One day before Yuan was set to leave the city for his training, a familiar figure approached him in the cafeteria.
"Do you have some time after this?" Li Jieyu asked him.
"Are you looking to spar with me again?"
She quietly nodded.
"Why?"
"I want to see how much I've closed our gap since our last spar," she admitted.
"In that case, allow me to save you some time and pain. You didn't close the gap at all. If anything, it got even wider."
Li Jieyu frowned at his words, but before she could respond, Yuan continued, "But if you really want to spar with me, then join my squad."
"What does that have to do with joining your squad?"
"Because my time is precious, and unless someone is a member of my squad, I find it difficult to spare any time for them."
"Take your time and think it over. I'll be leaving the city for three months tomorrow, anyway."
Li Jieyu stood there in silence for a moment before turning around. However, before walking away, she suddenly asked, "What was the name of your squad again?"
"Nine Heavens."
"Noted."
With that, she left the cafeteria.

chapters.title: Chapter 2702 Level 3 Black Zone(3)
paragraphs: The following day, a few hours before Yuan was scheduled to enter the Level 3 Black Zone, Supreme General Tian asked one of the soldiers monitoring Yuan about his current situation.
"He's spent the last several days at the cafeteria. In fact, he was still at the cafeteria when I was replaced."
"What do you mean he spent several days in the cafeteria? What was he doing there?"
"Um... he was eating..."
"You're telling me that it took him several days to finish his meals?"
"No, he ate everything the cafeteria had to offer... some more than once."
"What the hell is he doing...?" Supreme General Tian shook his head, unable to comprehend Yuan's actions in the slightest.

One would expect Yuan to spend his time preparing for the Level 3 Black Zone, just as Supreme General Tian had, but instead, he spent all that time in the cafeteria stuffing his face with food, almost as if he weren't heading to one of the most dangerous places in this world soon.
Some time later, Yuan met up with Supreme General Tian at the western entrance.
"Looks like you're actually coming with me by yourself," Yuan remarked.
"Isn't that obvious? Or were you expecting me to secretly bring other soldiers along?" Supreme General Tian frowned.
Yuan merely shook his head.
"Anyways, I'm ready to leave whenever you are."
"Follow me."
They left the city shortly after, with Yuan following Supreme General Tian closely.
"We'll travel to the Black Zone normally for now, but once we reach level two, we'll travel on the flying treasure, which will help conceal our presence," said Supreme General Tian as they traveled.
"Alright."
A little over a month later, they arrived at the Level 2 Black Zone.

Upon their arrival, Supreme General Tian retrieved the same flying treasure they'd used before and made it their main mode of transportation. However, it didn't travel through the void; it merely flew normally in open air.
This way, it used less energy, at the cost of some speed. But it was the safest way for them to reach the Level 3 Black Zone.
"Is this really necessary?" Yuan asked when he realized the Supreme General had no intention of using it to travel through the void.
"I can defeat the Void Specters in this area in the blink of an eye, so this level of caution seems pointless."
Supreme General Tian calmly looked at him and replied, "If you want to waste your energy before arriving at our destination, by all means, go ahead."
Yuan then asked, "How long before we arrive?"
"Two weeks."
"General Mei said that I only had three months to train... That doesn't include our travel time, does it?"
"No, it doesn't. You can stay in the Level 3 Black Zone for three months if you're capable enough, but I have a feeling you'll be finished long before then."
"That sounds like a challenge."
Supreme General Tian sneered and spoke with confidence, "If you can last three months in the Level 3 Black Zone, I'll allow you to leave the city to train alone."
"Oh? I'll accept that challenge."
"Let me finish," Supreme General Tian said before he continued, "If you cannot last three months, you'll have to reveal your secrets to me."
"Aren't you worried that I might lie?"
"I have my ways to ensure you tell the truth."
Yuan nodded with a smile.
"Deal."
The next moment, Yuan jumped off the flying treasure and began following it from the outside, defeating every Void Specter they encountered without slowing down.
'This damn monster...' Supreme General Tian sighed inwardly.
Time passed swiftly, and before they knew it, two weeks had gone by and they had arrived at the border of the Level 3 Black Zone.

Unsurprisingly, the atmosphere within the Level 3 Black Zone was several times heavier than that of Level 2, giving Yuan a familiar sensation that reminded him of the Endless Assault on the 40th floor and beyond.
"I will continue to observe you from the flying treasure," Supreme General Tian said to Yuan from the ship.
"Do as you please," Yuan replied before entering the Level 3 Black Zone for the first time.

Meanwhile, Supreme General Tian followed from a safe distance. Although the flying treasure perfectly concealed his presence, that alone wasn't enough in a place like this, as there was still a chance he could be detected, so he remained vigilant aboard the vessel.
Just a few minutes after Yuan entered the Level 3 Black Zone, he encountered his first Void Specter.
"That looks like..." Yuan swallowed nervously as he stared at the creature before him, which resembled a dragon with a single black wing protruding from the right side of its back.

However, what truly made his skin crawl was the sheer amount of energy radiating from its presence. It was several times more powerful than any Void Specter he had encountered before, with the sole exception of the Void Hunter.
"Let's see what you're—"
Right as Yuan prepared to attack it, the Void Specter suddenly looked in his direction with its mouth wide open.
The very next moment, the creature unleashed a massive breath attack wide enough to wipe out an entire city.

Yuan avoided it without difficulty using Void Manipulation, but Supreme General Tian, who was right behind him, was forced to activate the flying treasure's ability to enter the void, consuming a sizable portion of the vessel's energy.
Situations like this were precisely why he was never completely safe, even aboard the flying treasure. Moreover, its energy would eventually run out.
After confirming that Supreme General Tian was still alive, Yuan focused his attention on the Void Specter.
"Quite the warm welcome. I suppose I should return the favor," Yuan muttered before unleashing five trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence, slamming it into the Void Specter with tremendous force.
BOOM!
The Void Specter was sent flying before crashing into the ground with a heavy thud. However, it didn't appear to be dead, and sure enough, it rose back to its feet a moment later.

chapters.title: Chapter 2703 Ten Trillion Years' of Eternal Essence
paragraphs: 'Not even five trillion years' of Eternal Essence could kill it in one hit, huh? These guys are at least twice as durable as the ones in Level 2...' Yuan thought to himself as he watched the Void Specter get back to its feet, acting like it was barely harmed.
Once it was back on all fours, the Void Specter suddenly took to the skies—something Yuan had never seen a Void Specter do before—and began viciously flapping its single wing.
A moment later, a dozen black spheres, each the size of a massive boulder, materialized around it.

At a glance, the attack appeared ordinary, but Yuan felt an ominous sensation in his gut. When he examined the black spheres more closely, he could clearly sense the Power of the Void contained within them.
"It's using the Power of the Void in its attacks...?" Yuan muttered with a surprised expression, as he'd never seen it done before.

'No! Now that I think about it, I've seen this before! I just didn't realize what it was back then because my understanding was too shallow!' Yuan cried inwardly, recalling how the entity on the 46th floor had managed to attack him even while he was within the void.

At the time, he had assumed it was simply due to the difference in their understanding of the void. While that was true, the main reason was that the entity had learned to wield the Power of the Void itself, much like how a swordsman wielded Sword Aura.
'I didn't realize the Power of the Void could be used like this...' Yuan thought, inwardly shaking his head at himself for not considering it sooner.

In his defense, however, the Power of the Void was practically unexplored territory for cultivators in the Nine Heavens. Even those capable of using it could only tap into its power at a superficial level.
Of course, this included Yuan's past lives as well. In fact, his current level of Void Understanding had already surpassed anything he had ever achieved in any of his previous lives.
'Although I know what it's doing... can I even replicate it with my current level of Void Understanding?' Yuan wondered, itching to try it.
Unfortunately, Yuan had no time to experiment, as the Void Specter had already launched its attack.

His first instinct was to use Void Manipulation to evade it, but if he had learned anything from his battle on the 46th floor of Endless Assault, it was that an attack infused with the Power of the Void could still reach him even while he was inside the void. In fact, being struck there could be even more dangerous than taking the attack normally.

The attacks were also too large to evade normally—or rather, doing so would require more effort than Yuan cared to expend. Therefore, he decided to simply take the attack head-on and see what would happen.
"What is that crazy bastard doing?! Why isn't he moving?! Don't tell me he plans on taking the attack with his body?!" Supreme General Tian exclaimed in disbelief as he watched Yuan from afar.
The next moment, the black spheres descended upon Yuan like a dozen meteors, causing the entire plain to tremble violently on impact.
Once the dust settled, several massive craters scarred the ground. At the center of the deepest one stood Yuan, seemingly unharmed aside from a thin trail of blood at the corner of his lips.
A smile tugged at Yuan's lips as he thought to himself, 'Looks like my physique can absorb their attacks as well...'

Aside from his battle with the Void Hunter, Yuan had never sustained any real damage while fighting a Void Specter, so he had never gotten the chance to test whether his physique could absorb the energy from their attacks too.
Not only did being struck by the attack increase his Limitless, but it also improved his Void Understanding by a tiny amount.
"Unfortunately, I didn't come here to improve my Void Understanding, but to increase my power, and I don't have the time to play with you any longer..."
Yuan fought back shortly later, attacking the Void Specter with more and more power until it was defeated.
After several attacks, Yuan finally managed to defeat it with six and a half trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence, which was more power than he'd expected.

'If Level 3 requires so much Eternal Essence, just how much will Level 4 require...?' Yuan wondered inwardly as he absorbed the energy from the Void Specter, increasing his Eternal Essence by about three hundred billion years.

Once he was finished, Yuan immediately set off in search of his next prey. Fortunately, he didn't have to look far, as the commotion from his earlier battle had already drawn in the nearby Void Specters.
Over the next several days, Yuan fought Void Specters almost nonstop, sometimes taking on several at once.

However, because defeating even a single one consumed a tremendous amount of energy, he often needed time to recover before moving on to the next fight, so he wasn't able to delete Void Specters as he had in the weaker zones.

"This guy is definitely not human..." Supreme General Tian muttered in a dazed voice as he watched Yuan fight several Void Specters at once, something he'd never even heard of, much less witnessed with his own eyes.
Time passed in the blink of an eye, and before Yuan realized it, an entire month had gone by since he entered the Level 3 Black Zone.

Although defeating each Void Specter took considerable time and effort, the rewards were equally substantial, allowing his Eternal Essence to grow at a much faster rate than it had in the Level 2 Black Zone.
Eight trillion... nine trillion... nine and a half trillion years...
Yuan's Eternal Essence steadily approached ten trillion years—the threshold at which he would finally become capable of harming Eternals.
Finally, after a month and a half of training, Yuan reached his goal. Of course, he had no intention of stopping there and planned to increase his Eternal Essence as much as possible.
Unfortunately, he soon encountered an unexpected bottleneck.
<Due to your incomplete Eternal Constitution, your body cannot contain any more Eternal Essence>
The notification hovered before Yuan, leaving him momentarily speechless.

After several attacks, Yuan finally managed to defeat it with six and a half trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence, which was more power than he'd expected.

'If Level 3 requires so much Eternal Essence, just how much will Level 4 require...?' Yuan wondered inwardly as he absorbed the energy from the Void Specter, increasing his Eternal Essence by about three hundred billion years.
Once he was finished, Yuan immediately set off in search of his next prey.
Fortunately, he didn't have to look far, as the commotion from his earlier battle had already drawn in the nearby Void Specters.
Over the next several days, Yuan fought Void Specters almost nonstop, sometimes taking on several at once.

However, because defeating even a single one consumed a tremendous amount of energy, he often needed time to recover before moving on to the next fight, so he wasn't able to delete Void Specters as he had in the weaker zones.

"This guy is definitely not human..." Supreme General Tian muttered in a dazed voice as he watched Yuan fight several Void Specters at once, something he'd never even heard of, much less witnessed with his own eyes.
Time passed in the blink of an eye, and before Yuan realized it, an entire month had gone by since he entered the Level 3 Black Zone.

Although defeating each Void Specter took considerable time and effort, the rewards were equally substantial, allowing his Eternal Essence to grow at a much faster rate than it had in the Level 2 Black Zone.
Eight trillion... nine trillion... nine and a half trillion years...
Yuan's Eternal Essence steadily approached ten trillion years—the threshold at which he would finally become capable of harming Eternals.
Finally, after a month and a half of training, Yuan reached his goal.
Of course, he had no intention of stopping there and planned to increase his Eternal Essence as much as possible.
Unfortunately, he soon encountered an unexpected bottleneck.
<Due to your incomplete Eternal Constitution, your body cannot contain any more Eternal Essence>
The notification hovered before Yuan, leaving him momentarily speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 2704 Level 4 Black Zone
paragraphs: <Due to your incomplete Eternal Constitution, your body cannot contain any more Eternal Essence>
Yuan stared at the notification with a blank face, blinking several times in quick succession, looking like he couldn't believe what he was seeing.
"My body cannot contain any more Eternal Essence...?" he muttered in a daze.
However, he quickly snapped out of it and sighed aloud, "Why am I even surprised? This should've been expected."

He quickly realized he shouldn't have been surprised. If anything, he should've expected this outcome, as this wasn't the first time his physique had hit bottlenecks, especially during his earlier days when he still had the Heaven Refining Physique.
"Now what?" he mumbled to himself.
Now that he'd hit a bottleneck, there was no point trying to improve his Eternal Essence. Of course, he could progress toward completing his Eternal Constitution.
But there was one problem. One major problem.
'How the hell am I supposed to complete my physique in this world? Not only do I lack the materials to do so, but I am not even in my real body!' he cried inwardly.
It quickly became clear that it was impossible for him to complete his physique for as long as he remained in this world.
'I really need to hurry up and meet Gaia and leave this place...' he sighed inwardly.
Yuan turned his attention to the Void Specter slowly approaching from a distance, its appearance resembling a mammoth.
'Although I cannot improve my Eternal Essence, I can still strengthen my cultivation...'
Since Limitless derived from Eternal Essence, he could still improve his cultivation through it.

After defeating the Void Specter, Yuan absorbed its energy. However, instead of absorbing it in its pure form as Eternal Essence, he used the Limitless Cultivation Technique to convert it into Limitless.
<Your cultivation has reached Fifth Level Sixth Ascension>
<Your cultivation has reached Sixth Level Sixth Ascension>
<Your cultivation has reached Seventh Level Sixth Ascension>
His cultivation increased by three levels in the blink of an eye.
With nothing else to do, Yuan spent the rest of his time in the Level 3 Black Zone to increase his cultivation level.
<Your cultivation has reached First Level Seventh Ascension>
<Your cultivation has reached Ninth Level Seventh Ascension>
<Your cultivation has reached First Level Eighth Ascension>
"What the hell is going on?! His cultivation suddenly started improving at a ridiculous rate, and it hasn't stopped since then!" Supreme General Tian exclaimed in disbelief after noticing the change.
Yuan's three-month training session eventually ended, and he returned to the flying ship.
"I won the challenge. From now on, I'll be able to leave the city on my own, right?"
Supreme General Tian nodded in a daze.
"By the way, where is the Level 4 Black Zone?" Yuan suddenly asked, a curious expression on his face.
Supreme General Tian immediately frowned.
"Don't even think about it," he said sternly.
However, Yuan suddenly turned to look in a certain direction and smiled.
"Is it in that direction? I can sense something ominous coming from there," he remarked. "I want to take a look."
"Absolutely not! Do you have a death wish?!" Supreme General Tian shouted.
"Are you going back on your word?"
"This and that are two different matters! You may have permission to train outside as you wish, but you do not have permission to enter the Level 4 Black Zone!"
Yuan smiled and replied, "Who said I was going inside? I merely want to take a look at it from the outside."
After saying that, Yuan jumped off the flying ship and flew toward the place he'd just been looking at.
"This crazy bastard!"
Supreme General Tian had no choice but to chase after him.
A few days later—
"Stop! If you go any further than this, you'll enter the Level 4 Black Zone!" Supreme General Tian warned him.
Yuan suddenly slowed down, though not because of Supreme General Tian's words. Instead, something in the distance had caught his attention.
"What is that?" Yuan asked, narrowing his gaze at the tree-like silhouette on the horizon.
Supreme General Tian stared at the distant silhouette for a few seconds before responding, "We don't know. No one has ever made it that far. However, we call it the Grand Tree."
He paused briefly before continuing, "There are many theories surrounding its existence. Some even believe it may be the origin of the Void Specters."

Yuan continued staring at the Grand Tree. Although he could only make out its distant silhouette, a strange sensation gradually began to stir within him—an inexplicable urge to approach it, almost as though the tree itself were beckoning him closer.
'I have to get closer to it,' he thought inwardly.

Unfortunately, there was a good chance he wouldn't make it that far. The presences emanating from deeper within the area were simply too overwhelming, even for him. In fact, some of them felt even stronger than the entity on the 48th floor.
"Let's go. You've seen enough." Supreme General Tian said a moment later.
Yuan nodded.
However, just as Yuan turned around and prepared to leave, he sensed a familiar presence suddenly appear out of thin air like a ghost.
The next moment, the atmosphere changed drastically, and the temperature plummeted.
"T-This atmosphere?! Impossible!"
Supreme General Tian's complexion changed instantly, his face turning deathly pale as though all the blood had been drained from it.
"WE NEED TO LEAVE! IMMEDIATELY!" he shouted at Yuan.
Yuan shook his head, pointed at the human-like silhouette that had just materialized, and said, "I think it's a little too late for that."
This silhouette belonged to none other than the Void Hunter.
"Why is it appearing now?! There are only two of us here!" Supreme General Tian gritted his teeth so hard that his gums bled.
Without looking at Supreme General Tian, Yuan spoke, "Leave. I'll hold him off for as long as I can."
However, to his surprise, Supreme General Tian sneered and replied, "Who the hell do you think you are to command me? Last I checked, you're still my underling."
He left the flying treasure and continued, "I am not going anywhere without you."

chapters.title: Chapter 2705 Void Hunter's Second Appearance
paragraphs: "Won't leave without me? That's not something you're qualified to say, Supreme General or not," Yuan said boldly. "If you don't leave now, you'll really die."
"Sounds like early retirement to me," Supreme General Tian remarked with a cold smile.
Still, Yuan saw the corner of his mouth tremble slightly.
"And how am I supposed to explain things to General Mei and the others if I return alone?" Yuan sighed. "Even if I don't die here, I'll die back home when they execute me for your death."
"Don't worry. I'm recording everything, and the footage will automatically be sent back to base the moment the recording ends. They'll know you weren't responsible."
Yuan silently shook his head, no longer bothering to convince him. Instead, he focused his full attention on the Void Hunter rapidly approaching them, its presence radiating a menacing aura.
Once the Void Hunter was close enough, Yuan muttered, "Sorry, old man, but I won't be able to fight it properly with you in the way."
"O-Old man?! How dare—"
"This is for your own good," Yuan interrupted.
Before Supreme General Tian could comprehend it, Yuan tapped his shoulder and used Void Manipulation to teleport him far away.
"T-That bastard!" Supreme General Tian trembled in anger after realizing what had happened, but he was also astonished, as he'd never seen anyone use Void Control to teleport someone else away.
He wanted to rush back to Yuan, but the moment he sensed their auras clashing and the pressure in their area, Supreme General Tian swallowed nervously and decided to stay out of it.
Despite his outward bravery, he had never truly wanted to fight the Void Hunter, and Yuan had just given him the perfect excuse to back down.
Meanwhile, the Void Hunter took its sweet time approaching Yuan, almost as though it knew he had no intention of running away.
Eventually, the two stood face-to-face, their auras colliding with such intensity that the space around them visibly warped, resembling the shimmering air above a desert during a heat wave.
"I am life...
The Void Hunter suddenly started speaking.
"I am death..."
"I am—"

Before it could finish, Yuan pulled his hand back and launched a punch straight at its face, putting almost all ten trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence into it, essentially using his full strength from the get-go.
Yuan expected the Void Hunter to arrogantly tank his hit like before, but to his surprise, it actually dodged the attack.
'I have a chance!' Yuan thought to himself after seeing it.
After evading Yuan's attack, the Void Hunter immediately retaliated.
And just like that, Yuan's second battle with the Void Hunter began, their clashes shaking the heavens nonstop.
Supreme General Tian watched from afar, his mouth hanging open wide enough to fit an entire apple.
It was the first time he had ever witnessed such a fierce battle. To him, it looked as though two gods of war, equal in both skill and power, were locked in a relentless clash.

After several hundred exchanges with the Void Hunter, Yuan became confident that he had grown strong enough to fight it on relatively even footing. Of course, that didn't necessarily mean he could defeat it.

Their fight continued for hours without rest. Fortunately, they were far away from the other cities, so their fight didn't affect them in the slightest. In fact, nobody even knew such a fight was happening.

'This won't do! Although I am strong enough to fight it properly, it's not enough to defeat him. At this rate, we'll just keep on fighting until one of us gets bored.' Yuan thought to himself, and he started contemplating how he could defeat the Void Hunter.
Suddenly, Yuan had a realization.
'Surely, there has to be a better way to use Eternal Essence. The way I'm using it right now is no different from those cultivators in Gaia's Sanctum!' Yuan cried inwardly.

He realized his current method of wielding Eternal Essence was incredibly crude—almost no different from an inexperienced cultivator blindly throwing around their spiritual energy without using any proper techniques.
However, to wield Eternal Essence properly, Yuan needed a suitable technique—one specifically designed to utilize its power. Unfortunately, he did not have anything like that.
'Wait a second... I do have a technique I can use!'
Some time later, when he recovered enough energy, Yuan's aura abruptly changed, and the temperature around them dropped even further, plummeting so much that the ground around them began to freeze.
The moment Yuan saw an opening, he unleashed the technique.
<Shiva's Eternal Frost!>
In the next instant, ten trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence erupted as an unfathomably cold energy, instantly freezing the Void Hunter along with everything within tens of thousands of miles.
In a single moment, the surrounding landscape was transformed into an entirely new frozen biome.
Not only that, but the temperature across the entire world plummeted drastically—enough for everyone to notice, as their breaths suddenly became visible as clouds of mist.
Supreme General Tian, who was the second closest person to Yuan, nearly froze into a statue himself.
"What in Gaia's name is this power?!" he cried out, shivering uncontrollably as he stared at the frozen landscape before him in terror.
He'd seen and experienced many things throughout his life, but nothing could've prepared him for this.
Meanwhile, Yuan stayed focused on the Void Hunter who was encased in a mountain of ice, certain it hadn't been defeated yet.
Sure enough, half a minute later, the ice mountain trembled.
The next moment, Yuan watched as the massive mountain, tall enough to pierce the sky, vaporized into nothingness.
Seeing this, he immediately prepared to continue fighting the Void Hunter.
However, the Void Hunter merely lifted its head to look at Yuan in silence, almost as if it were contemplating something.
Eventually, it spoke in a low voice, "You are...not worthy."
Then, without explanation, it vanished into thin air, disappearing as suddenly as it appeared, leaving Yuan speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 2706 Otherworldly Power
paragraphs: "Even ten trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence isn't enough to hurt it, huh?" Yuan released a deep sigh after the Void Hunter vanished.
This meant that the Void Hunter was at least on the level of an Eternal.
'Fortunately, it doesn't seem to be on the level of a Primal Eternal.' Yuan thought to himself.
Unfortunately, because his Eternal Constitution was incomplete, he had no way to increase his Eternal Essence, making it impossible to defeat the Void Hunter.
'If I cannot defeat the Void Hunter, how am I going to meet Gaia now?' Yuan sighed inwardly, as it was the condition for him to meet them.
In the end, he had no choice but to figure it out later.
Some time later, Yuan returned to Supreme General Tian.
"Let's return to the city now," Yuan said.
However, Supreme General Tian remained silent, a contemplative expression on his face.
He wanted to question Yuan about the power he had just used, but ultimately decided against it, knowing Yuan would most likely refuse to answer.
"We're leaving."

Supreme General Tian retrieved the flying treasure and immediately activated its ability once Yuan was onboard, entering the void for several minutes before emerging again—only to repeat the process shortly afterward.
He continued doing this until they returned to Gaia's Heaven, consuming a tremendous amount of the treasure's energy, even using Unknown Crystals to replenish it when it ran low.
Such a costly method of travel was normally reserved for emergencies, but Supreme General Tian wanted to return to the city as soon as possible.
A few days later, they returned to the city.
"You're not allowed to go anywhere until I say so," Supreme General Tian told Yuan before leaving without explanation.
Yuan didn't complain or mind it, as he needed time to ponder his next course of action anyway.
After leaving Yuan, Supreme General Tian headed straight to the Chief of Operations and said, "You need to watch this."
Without any explanation, he showed Yu Rou the recording of Yuan's training, but he sped up the footage until they reached near the end.
"Wait... the Void Hunter appeared when there were only two of you...?" Yu Rou muttered with a dumbfounded expression.
It was the first time she had ever heard of anything like that.
But when she saw Yuan fight the Void Hunter a few minutes later, she was completely astonished.

"You said that he was toyed around by the Void Hunter during their first encounter? He seems to be on equal footing with it right now, and if he's grown this much in such a short time..." Yu Rou muttered.
Because Ember City refused to share footage of Yuan's first fight with the Void Hunter, only those who attended the assembly had seen it.
Supreme General Tian nodded and said, "The difference is like night and day, but this is just the very beginning."

Eventually, she reached the part where Yuan unleashed Shiva's Eternal Frost, encasing the Void Hunter within a massive mountain of ice and transforming the surrounding landscape into a frozen wasteland that stretched for thousands of miles.
Yu Rou stood up from her seat and stared at the screen with wide eyes, her mouth slightly agape.
"W-What kind of power is this?!" she exclaimed in disbelief.
"I didn't ask him since I doubt he'd be willing to tell me," Supreme General Tian sighed. "But I'm willing to bet it's an otherworldly power, considering he claims to have come from another world."
Supreme General Tian had been reluctant to believe Yuan's claim that he came from another world, but after witnessing such otherworldly power firsthand, he could no longer deny it.
"One can't help but wonder how many more secrets he's hiding after seeing something like that..." Yu Rou wondered aloud.
Once the video ended after the Void Hunter disappeared, Yu Rou remained silent for a couple of moments before turning to Supreme General Tian and asking, "What if it's Gaia?"
"Excuse me?" Supreme General Tian tilted his head, looking puzzled by her question.
"He won't reveal his secrets to anyone, right? But what if we fulfill his desire to meet Gaia?"
"You can't be serious!" Supreme General Tian exclaimed.
"I'm against it."
"I would like to hear your reasoning."
"There's still far too much we don't know about him! It's too risky."
Yu Rou shook her head and sighed, "How can you still say that after watching his fight with the Void Hunter?"
"Wh-What do you mean?"

"Regardless of his secrets, it's clear that he's willing to fight the Void Hunter. Not only that, but he refused to let you pointlessly sacrifice your life. In my eyes, he's already trustworthy enough. More importantly...
She turned her gaze toward Yuan's handsome face on the screen.
"That otherworldly power of his... We'll need it when the inevitable invasion begins in the near future."
Supreme General Tian sighed after a moment of silence.
"If that's what you really want to do, then so be it."
Yu Rou nodded with a serious expression on her face.
"Let him know that Gaia agrees to meet with him."
Meanwhile, Yuan contemplated how he could meet Gaia without defeating the Void Hunter as he stuffed his face with food in the cafeteria, unaware that his meeting with her had already been decided.
Suddenly, he noticed a familiar figure approaching his table.
"Are you here to eat, too? Or did you come here specifically for me?" Yuan asked the masked figure before him.
"In case you forgot, the follow-up assembly will happen soon," said Ironwoman as she sat across from him.
Yuan stopped eating at her words.
"Now that you mention it... I forgot about it."
"That's precisely why I came here to find you," Ironwoman said, shaking her head slightly.
"Anyway, how was your training? I heard that you'd gone into the Level 3 Black Zone."
"Aside from a few unexpected situations, it was fine."
"What sort?"
"For one, the Void Hunter's appearance."
"What did you just say?!" Ironwoman exclaimed loudly, startling the entire cafeteria.

"You're not allowed to go anywhere until I say so," Supreme General Tian told Yuan before leaving without explanation.
Yuan didn't complain or mind it, as he needed time to ponder his next course of action anyway.
After leaving Yuan, Supreme General Tian headed straight to the Chief of Operations and said, "You need to watch this."
Without any explanation, he showed Yu Rou the recording of Yuan's training, but he sped up the footage until they reached near the end.
"Wait... the Void Hunter appeared when there were only two of you...?" Yu Rou muttered with a dumbfounded expression.
It was the first time she had ever heard of anything like that.
But when she saw Yuan fight the Void Hunter a few minutes later, she was completely astonished.
"You said that he was toyed around by the Void Hunter during their first encounter?
He seems to be on equal footing with it right now, and if he's grown this much in such a short time..." Yu Rou muttered.
Because Ember City refused to share footage of Yuan's first fight with the Void Hunter, only those who attended the assembly had seen it.
Supreme General Tian nodded and said, "The difference is like night and day, but this is just the very beginning."

Eventually, she reached the part where Yuan unleashed Shiva's Eternal Frost, encasing the Void Hunter within a massive mountain of ice and transforming the surrounding landscape into a frozen wasteland that stretched for thousands of miles.
Yu Rou stood up from her seat and stared at the screen with wide eyes, her mouth slightly agape.
"W-What kind of power is this?!" she exclaimed in disbelief.
"I didn't ask him since I doubt he'd be willing to tell me," Supreme General Tian sighed.
"But I'm willing to bet it's an otherworldly power, considering he claims to have come from another world."
Supreme General Tian had been reluctant to believe Yuan's claim that he came from another world, but after witnessing such otherworldly power firsthand, he could no longer deny it.
"One can't help but wonder how many more secrets he's hiding after seeing something like that..." Yu Rou wondered aloud.
Once the video ended after the Void Hunter disappeared, Yu Rou remained silent for a couple of moments before turning to Supreme General Tian and asking, "What if it's Gaia?"
"Excuse me?" Supreme General Tian tilted his head, looking puzzled by her question.
"He won't reveal his secrets to anyone, right?
But what if we fulfill his desire to meet Gaia?"
"You can't be serious!" Supreme General Tian exclaimed.
"I'm against it."
"I would like to hear your reasoning."
"There's still far too much we don't know about him!
It's too risky."
Yu Rou shook her head and sighed, "How can you still say that after watching his fight with the Void Hunter?"
"Wh-What do you mean?"
"Regardless of his secrets, it's clear that he's willing to fight the Void Hunter.
Not only that, but he refused to let you pointlessly sacrifice your life.
In my eyes, he's already trustworthy enough.
More importantly...
She turned her gaze toward Yuan's handsome face on the screen.
"That otherworldly power of his...
We'll need it when the inevitable invasion begins in the near future."
Supreme General Tian sighed after a moment of silence.
"If that's what you really want to do, then so be it."
Yu Rou nodded with a serious expression on her face.
"Let him know that Gaia agrees to meet with him."
Meanwhile, Yuan contemplated how he could meet Gaia without defeating the Void Hunter as he stuffed his face with food in the cafeteria, unaware that his meeting with her had already been decided.
Suddenly, he noticed a familiar figure approaching his table.
"Are you here to eat, too?
Or did you come here specifically for me?" Yuan asked the masked figure before him.
"In case you forgot, the follow-up assembly will happen soon," said Ironwoman as she sat across from him.
Yuan stopped eating at her words.
"Now that you mention it...
I forgot about it."
"That's precisely why I came here to find you," Ironwoman said, shaking her head slightly.
"Anyway, how was your training?
I heard that you'd gone into the Level 3 Black Zone."
"Aside from a few unexpected situations, it was fine."
"What sort?"
"For one, the Void Hunter's appearance."
"What did you just say?!" Ironwoman exclaimed loudly, startling the entire cafeteria.

chapters.title: Chapter 2707 Midnight Squad
paragraphs: "Calm down, you're scaring everybody." Yuan chuckled at Ironwoman's reaction.
However, she ignored everyone's stares and asked after sitting back down, "The Void Hunter appeared again? I thought you only went to that place with the Supreme General."
Yuan nodded.
"Yes, it was only the two of us, but it still appeared. Granted, we were right outside the Level 4 Black Zone, so maybe that had something to do with it."
"Huh? The Level 4 Black Zone? Are you insane?" Ironwoman stared at him, wide-eyed behind her mask.
"We didn't enter it. We were at the borders."
"That's still extremely dangerous since it's possible for the Level 4 Void Specters to wander out into the Level 3 Black Zone."
"Is that so? In that case, what if the Void Hunter is actually something that lives within the Level 4 Black Zone?"
"When it's not hunting humans? Very likely, since nobody has seen it wandering the other zones, and nobody ever goes into the Level 4 Black Zone."
"By the way, how was your fight with the Void Hunter this time? Surely, you weren't toyed with by it like previously, right?"
Yuan shook his head and said, "No, I can fight it properly now, but that's only because it's still going easy on me, and I am still nowhere near defeating it."

Ironwoman fell silent, and a moment later, she spoke, "In any case, back on topic. They have already set a date for the assembly. It will happen exactly six months from now, so make sure you're free around that time because you'll definitely need to be there."
Yuan nodded and said, "That won't be a problem since I won't be going out to train anymore."
"Huh? Why not?"
"Let's just say that I need a break, especially after my fight with the Void Hunter."
"If you say so..."
Ironwoman left shortly after, and Yuan kept eating in the cafeteria for a few more hours until someone else interrupted him.
The individual, wearing full black armor, was a member of the Supreme General's Midnight Squad.
"The Supreme General has summoned you. Follow me."
"Let me finish what's on the table first," Yuan calmly replied.
"You dare make the Supreme General wait?" The soldier frowned behind his mask.
"I'm sure he can wait a few minutes. I don't want to waste any food."

With that, Yuan continued eating, leaving the soldiers around them speechless. The Midnight Squad made up an entire division—the 10th Division—with authority second only to the generals, regardless of their actual ranks.
The Midnight Squad soldier trembled at Yuan's audacity.
"I don't care if you can fight the Void Hunter. When you're in the military, you will obey orders!"
However, Yuan ignored him and continued eating in silence.
Seeing this, the Midnight Squad soldier moved and grabbed the edge of the table with both hands.
However, before he could do anything else, Yuan spoke.
"Think twice before doing something you'll regret."
The soldier froze for a split second, but then sneered disdainfully. The next moment, he flipped the table over, sending everything on it flying to the side.
"Your meal is over now," he said coldly.
Yuan sighed and rose to his feet, turning to face the soldier.
"What are you going to do now? Hit me?"
"No, but I will give you a choice."
Yuan pointed to the food on the ground and continued, "You can either willingly finish eating the food so it doesn't go to waste, or it will be done against your will."
"I'd like to see you try forcing me," the soldier replied confidently.

Although everyone knew Yuan could fight the Void Hunter, his powers were suppressed in the city, so he was no different from an ordinary person right now. Moreover, the soldier had an ace up his sleeve.
"Alright," Yuan muttered.
Then, without another word, he grabbed the soldier by the back of his neck, forced him to his knees, and shoved his face down toward the food scattered across the floor.
'What tremendous strength!' The soldier was caught off guard by Yuan's raw strength, but he didn't panic.
Suddenly, Limitless surged from the soldier's body.

Normally, the use of Limitless within the city was only permitted under special circumstances, such as during recruitment or designated training sessions. However, members of the 10th Division possessed the authority to bypass that restriction whenever they deemed it necessary.

Those watching expected Yuan to immediately regret laying a hand on a member of the Midnight Squad. However, to their shock, he continued forcing the soldier's face toward the ground without the slightest hesitation.
The soldier unleashed even more of his Limitless, but even after pushing himself to his limit, he was still unable to resist Yuan's overwhelming strength.
'How is this possible?! There's no way he can overpower me without using Limitless!' he cried inwardly.
That's when he noticed the hand gripping the back of his neck was also surging with Limitless.
'He's using Limitless?! Did the Supreme General grant him the authority to remove the restriction, too?!'
Upon realizing his miscalculation, the soldier swiftly apologized, "I was wrong!"
However, Yuan didn't respond and continued inching his face toward the food on the floor.
Once he was close enough, Yuan removed his mask so he could eat properly.
Eventually, the soldier's face was pressed directly into the food.
"Eat it," Yuan commanded in a cold tone.
"What's wrong? Why aren't you eating? Do you want me to forcefully shove the food in your mouth instead?"
Upon hearing his threat, the soldier finally began eating the food himself.
The spectators watched in shock and disbelief, wondering what the consequences of Yuan's action would be.
After all, nobody has ever done such a thing to a member of the Midnight Squad before.

"The faster you eat, the faster I'll meet with the Supreme General," Yuan remarked as he let go of the soldier and took a seat at a nearby table, continuing to watch the soldier eat off the floor like a dog.

chapters.title: Chapter 2708 Midnight Squad(2)
paragraphs: After watching the soldier finish his meal off the ground for several minutes, Yuan turned his attention toward the cafeteria entrance, where even more members of the Midnight Squad had appeared and were rapidly approaching him with aggressive intent.
Unsurprisingly, the Midnight Squad had been notified shortly after the commotion began.
When the soldier on the ground noticed their arrival, he immediately stopped eating and looked toward them with visible relief, almost as though his saviors had finally arrived.
Yuan looked at him and said, "Who told you to stop? There's still food left on the floor."
Of course, the soldier ignored him. Instead, he quickly stood up and rushed over to his companions.
"H-He attacked me and forced me to eat food off the floor!" he cried, pointing at Yuan with a trembling finger.
"He started it." Yuan calmly shrugged.
"I don't care who started it. Assaulting a member of the 10th Division is a serious offense," said the soldier leading the Midnight Squad members.
"So the 10th Division can do whatever they want without facing any consequences simply because they serve directly under the Supreme General?" Yuan asked.
"I never said he wouldn't be punished for his actions," the soldier replied. "It's just that what you did is far more serious."
"Is that so?"
"In any case, we'll deal with you later, as the Supreme General is waiting for you."
However, Yuan remained seated and pointed at the food on the ground.
"I won't be leaving until he cleans up the food."
"Are you serious?"
"Does it look like I am joking?" Yuan responded with a stubborn expression. "And when the Supreme General asks what took me so long, I will tell him exactly why."
After a moment of silence, the group leader turned to the soldier who started it and said, "Hurry up and clean it up."
"What?!" The soldier stared at the group leader in disbelief.
"Because of your little stunt, the Supreme General will be kept waiting even longer. Consider this your punishment. Now hurry up!"
The soldier looked down at the food scattered across the floor with a bitter expression, clenching his fists tightly in frustration.
Unfortunately, he had no other choice.
The next moment, the soldier crouched back down and resumed eating the food off the floor, scooping it up with his hands and hurriedly shoving it into his mouth.
A few minutes later, the soldier cleaned up all the food off the ground.
Seeing this, Yuan nodded his head in satisfaction and finally stood up.
"Let's go," he said to the leader.
Without a word, the leader turned and began walking out of the cafeteria, leading Yuan to the Supreme General's office.
"The hell took you so long?" Supreme General Tian asked Yuan the moment he walked into the office.
Yuan responded exactly as he'd said he would, explaining the situation.
Supreme General Tian rubbed his eyes and sighed aloud, "Are you trying to offend the entire 10th Division or something?"
"If you can't keep your own soldiers under control, I'll do it for you," Yuan said seriously.
Supreme General Tian frowned at the remark.
However, rather than arguing with Yuan over such blatant disrespect, he simply chose to pretend he hadn't heard it.
"I will pretend I didn't hear that, so let's get straight to the point. You want to meet Gaia, correct?"
"Of course. Are you finally going to let me meet them?" Yuan asked, already expecting a no.
"Yes."
"Huh?" Yuan's eyes widened in surprise when Supreme General Tian gave the exact opposite response he had expected.
"Really?" he asked, just in case he misheard.
"Yes. Your meeting with Gaia has been approved. However, it will happen after the assembly, which will happen in six months."
"What made you change your mind?" Yuan asked out of curiosity.
"I didn't. If it were up to me, I would not let you meet Gaia. Unfortunately, this wasn't my decision."
'So it was the Chief of Operations, huh?' Yuan smiled inwardly.
"In any case, try to stay in the city until then. If you really want to leave the city to train, don't stay out for longer than three months, and make sure you let General Mei know in advance."
"I understand."
"Now get out of my office."
Yuan immediately left.
"Six months until I meet Gaia, huh? What should I do until then?" Yuan wondered as he made his way home.
When he arrived home, he noticed Mei Xiaoyun leaving hers.
"Where are you going?" Yuan asked her.
"Training."
Hearing her plans, Yuan suddenly had an idea.
"Hey, want to train with me? Outside the city, that is."
"Excuse me?" Mei Xiaoyun raised her eyebrows, looking puzzled by his question.
"Although our squad isn't fully established, we're still a squad. Let's do something squad-like for once."
"But we can't leave the city with just the two of us, even if you're a Captain."
"Don't worry, I'll grab two more individuals to come with us."
Mei Xiaoyun pondered for a moment, then nodded.
"Okay. Let's do it."
"You can keep on training normally for now. I'll go find the other two members now, and I'll let you know when we're ready."
After saying that, Yuan turned around and left.
Some time later, after asking around, Yuan found Huang Zhi Han's living quarters and knocked on her door.
"I'm coming." Huang Zhi Han's voice resounded from inside.
Once she opened the door, Yuan greeted her with a smile and said, "Hey, are you busy?"
"No, not really. Why are you asking?"
"I'm going to host a training session for our squad."
"Even though we only have three people?"
"Don't worry, we'll have enough people."
"If you say so..."
Although Huang Zhi Han didn't want to train, she didn't refuse, as it meant she got to spend more time with Yuan.
"By the way, do you know where Li Jiyue lives?" Yuan suddenly asked.
"No, I don't. Don't tell me you want to invite her, too?" Huang Zhi Han asked, raising an eyebrow.
"Yes, since she'll be part of our squad, too."

chapters.title: Chapter 2709 First Squad Training Session
paragraphs: "That woman will also join our squad...?" Huang Zhi Han mumbled, sounding a little dazed.
After a moment of silence, she continued, "Although I don't know where she lives, I know where you can find her."
"That woman is quite famous, and it's not because of her talents. They call her the Training Hall Princess because she spends all of her time training, practically living there."
"The training hall, huh? Alright. Thanks. I'll contact you again when I have a date for the training session."
With that, Yuan left and headed to the training hall.
After arriving, Yuan entered the building and walked through the training hall to look for Li Jieyu.
However, since most of the training rooms were private, Yuan could only hope to catch Li Jieyu during her breaks.
Some time later, Yuan finished walking through the entire training hall, but alas, he still couldn't find Li Jieyu.
'Since I am already here, I might as well do some training, too.'
Yuan headed to Simulated Combat to train on the 48th floor.

'My Eternal Essence has essentially doubled since my last attempt on the 48th floor...' Yuan thought as he entered one of the available rooms and started the simulation, feeling pretty confident about his victory.
Once inside, Yuan immediately started the simulation, and the Void Hunter look-alike appeared before him shortly later.
"Looking at you now, you're definitely not as strong as the real deal," Yuan muttered as he summoned his sword.
The two started clashing moments later.
'This is doable! I can defeat it!'
Yuan smiled inwardly after just several exchanges.

The difference between them wasn't great enough for Yuan to overwhelm his opponent with ease. Much like his battle with the Void Hunter, the fight was relatively even, though Yuan still held a clear advantage.

Eventually, Yuan unleashed Shiva's Eternal Frost with as much Eternal Essence as he could muster, instantly encasing his opponent within a massive mountain of ice. Unlike the Void Hunter, however, this opponent couldn't break free.
<You have cleared the 48th Floor>
However, Yuan didn't stop after the first clear and entered the 48th floor again.
This time, his purpose wasn't to defeat his opponent.
"If I want to defeat the Void Hunter... or Eternals for that matter, I will need to learn how to use Eternal Essence more efficiently."
"Shiva's Eternal Frost... Since it's my only Eternal-level technique right now, I should try to reach peak mastery with it before I even think about learning more."
Thus, Yuan started farming the Void Hunter on the 48th floor, using nothing but Shiva's Eternal Frost.
Meanwhile, those passing by the Simulated Combat area noticed that the rankings had changed once again.
"He's cleared the 48th floor now..."
"Huh? You know who this anonymous person is?"
"Pretty much everyone knows by now that it's Captain Yuan..."
"Right? I saw him entering the place not long ago, too. It has to be him.
After it was revealed that Yuan could fight the Void Hunter, almost everyone guessed Yuan was the anonymous individual at the top of the ranking.
"48th floor, huh? This means he's now only one floor away from reaching Tian Yuchen's record. How long do you think it'll take him to finally reach that level?"
"A monster like him? Hard to tell, but I wouldn't be surprised if he's already reached Tian Yuchen's level."
"Heavens... It's only been an hour, and he's already dropped his record to ten minutes."
"You think he'll be able to clear the 48th floor in seconds like before?"
"It's only a matter of time..."
Sure enough, Yuan eventually cleared the 48th floor in seven seconds.
Someone in the crowd, Li Jieyu, taking a break from her own training, stared at the rankings with a deep frown.
'The difference between us is too vast...' she sighed inwardly.
Minutes after setting his newest record, Yuan emerged from his training room to a large crowd outside. However, his gaze ignored everyone there and went straight to Li Jieyu.
He walked directly to her and said, "Hey, got some time right now?"
Li Jieyu raised an eyebrow and said, "I guess."
Yuan and Li Jieyu then left the scene quickly, leaving the others wondering about their relationship.
Some time later, once they were alone, Yuan asked her, "Have you decided to join my squad yet?"
"No," she immediately answered.

paragraphs: "I wasn't expecting such a drastic jump in difficulty," Mei Xiaoyun remarked after defeating the Void Specter, using more energy than she'd expected.
They continued wandering the Orange Zone shortly after, with Mei Xiaoyun defeating a few more Void Specters.
"If you want to fight more, just wait until we enter a tunnel," Yuan said to her.
Some time later, Yuan led them to a tunnel and entered it.

"This is a tunnel where you follow the path until you reach the end, but to do that, you'll have to clear the Void Specters blocking the way. At the end is a powerful Void Specter called the Void Guardian."

Yuan explained as he guided them through it, treating it like a school trip. And unlike outside, both Huang Zhi Han and Li Jieyu actually seemed interested, listening attentively, as even they had never been inside a tunnel before.
"The Void Specters in here are also stronger than the ones outside."
Eventually, they encountered a Void Specter.
"Anyone want to try fighting it?" Yuan asked them.
"Let me try," said Huang Zhi Han as she retrieved her weapon.
As the young lady of a wealthy family, it was only natural for Huang Zhi Han to possess her own weapon.
However, what caught Yuan's attention was how unusual it was.
Seven metallic orbs hovered around Huang Zhi Han like drones, and the moment she activated them, each one began firing Limitless like a gun, bombarding the Void Specter with bullets.
"What kind of weapon is that? Is it unique to Spirit City?" Yuan asked after she defeated the Void Specter.
"It's a new type of weapon that my family recently developed. I'm using it for testing," she said.
"Your family develops weapons?" Yuan raised an eyebrow after hearing this for the first time.
"You didn't know?" Huang Zhi Han looked at him with a somewhat surprised expression.
Even the other two seemed taken aback by Yuan's ignorance, as the Huang Family was one of the few families whose reputation extended far beyond the borders of their own city.
"My family is one of the largest weapon suppliers in the world," Huang Zhi Han explained. "We do business in all nine cities."
"Is that why you purchased so many Unknown Crystals back then?" Yuan asked, recalling her crazy shopping spree.
She nodded.
"Weapon creation requires a lot of energy, after all."
"Speaking of weapons..." Huang Zhi Han suddenly turned to look at Mei Xiaoyun before asking, "Why don't you have one? As the daughter of a General, you should be able to get one with ease."
"My mother did ask me if I wanted one, but I refused."
"If you don't mind me asking, why?"
"I don't want any special treatment. It's not like I need one, either."
"Is that so..."
They continued exploring the tunnel shortly later, with Huang Zhi Han and Mei Xiaoyun taking turns defeating Void Specters.
"Are you sure you don't want to fight one?" Yuan asked Li Jieyu.
"I want to fight the Void Guardian," she calmly replied.
Yuan raised an eyebrow at her words.
"What? Are you going to say it's too dangerous?"
Yuan smiled and replied, "No. If you want to fight the Void Guardian, go ahead."
As they neared the end of the tunnel, both Huang Zhi Han and Mei Xiaoyun were beginning to show signs of exhaustion.
"I'll take over for now," Yuan said.
Once Yuan started fighting the Void Specters, their pace increased tremendously, and they reached the end of the tunnel before long.
"Prepare yourself. The Void Guardian will start attacking the moment we enter its territory," Yuan said to Li Jieyu.
Li Jieyu nodded in acknowledgment.
"As for you two... stay close to me."
"Okay."
They jumped into the hole the next moment.
After several minutes of descending, they finally emerged into the chamber where the Void Guardian awaited them.
Li Jieyu drew her sword and attacked the Void Guardian without hesitation.
With a single swing, she unleashed a crescent-shaped arc of energy that shot toward the creature, resembling the way a swordmaster would wield Sword Aura.
The energy struck the Void Guardian, but the moment it made contact, the energy scattered in every direction, barely leaving a mark on the creature.
Seeing this, Li Jieyu immediately prepared another attack, gathering even more energy than before.
Meanwhile, the Void Guardian became fully aware of their presence and retaliated, launching several tentacle-like arms from its body and attacking not only Li Jieyu but Yuan and the others as well.
Li Jieyu used Void Control to avoid the attack, while Yuan blocked it with his own energy, completely nullifying it.
Over the next several minutes, Li Jieyu would throw everything she had at the Void Guardian, damaging it greatly.
However, despite how smoothly the battle seemed to be going, Li Jieyu knew she was nowhere close to defeating the Void Guardian. With the energy she had left, victory seemed impossible.
Even so, she refused to give up until she had exhausted every last drop of her energy and could no longer move.
Eventually, Li Jieyu lost consciousness and began falling from the air as the Void Guardian's attack homed in on her.
Seeing this, Yuan used Void Manipulation to close the distance.
After catching Li Jieyu, Yuan struck the Void Guardian with a burst of Limitless, flattening it instantly.
"Is she okay?" Mei Xiaoyun asked.
"She's fine."
"How reckless of her to keep fighting until she lost consciousness. What would've happened if you weren't here to save her?" Huang Zhi Han said, shaking her head.
Yuan smiled and said, "It's precisely because I am here that she's acting so recklessly. I did guarantee your safety, after all."
"Well, what now?"
"We collect the Unknown Ores and return to the city."
"Is this the end of our training session?"
"For now, yes. If you want, we can have more later. I have plenty of free time until the assembly, anyway."
"Alright."
Thus, they collected the Unknown Ores before leaving the tunnel.
A few hours later, Li Jieyu woke up to find herself hugging Yuan from behind.
"Looks like you're finally awake," Yuan remarked with a smile.
"I-I can move on my own," she said, her face flushed.
"If you say so."
After being released, Li Jieyu quietly followed them.
Upon returning to the city, Yuan said, "You guys can hand in the Unknown Ores for merit. Also, there's no need to credit me. I don't need it."
"Also, what did you think? Would you want to do it again?
"It was pretty fun. I wouldn't mind doing it again," Mei Xiaoyun said.
"Me too." Huang Zhi Han nodded her head in agreement.
Yuan turned to Li Jieyu, who stayed silent for a few moments before finally responding, "I will keep doing it until I can defeat a Void Guardian on my own."
Yuan nodded.
"Then let's do it again next month."
"Don't forget your promise," Li Jieyu suddenly said.
Yuan smiled and said, "I'll spar with you whenever you want."
"Tomorrow," she swiftly said.
"Sure. I'll meet you at the training hall tomorrow," Yuan said before looking at the other two and continuing, "You can join us if you'd like."
"Okay."
They nodded.
The next day, when Yuan arrived at the training hall, Li Jieyu and the other two were already there.
Once they were inside a private training room, Yuan said, "Since you're all so eager to grow stronger, I'll teach you how to increase your energy reserves and improve your recovery speed."
Li Jieyu's ears twitched at his words.
"You're willing to teach us your secret?" she asked doubtfully.
"It's not really a secret."
"Then what is it?"
"I'll tell you after we spar."
Shortly later, they started sparring, with Li Jieyu going first.
After Li Jieyu collapsed from exhaustion, Mei Xiaoyun went next, with Huang Zhi Han going last.
While they rested to recover their energy, Yuan revealed the secret behind his seemingly limitless energy.
"The 'secret' is quite simple. If you wish to improve your energy reserves and recovery speed, you just need to stop relying on the system and cultivate on your own."
"What?" Li Jieyu frowned at this revelation, mostly because she couldn't comprehend it.
"What do you mean by cultivating on our own?" Huang Zhi Han asked with a puzzled face.
"Exactly as it sounds. Instead of letting the system cultivate for you, you'll cultivate manually using a cultivation technique. The Limitless Cultivation Technique, for example."
"Cultivating through techniques? Are you messing with us? That is much slower than using the system!" Li Jieyu sneered.
"That may be the case at first, but as your understanding and mastery of the cultivation technique improves, so will your cultivation speed."
Yuan suddenly sat down in the lotus position and said, "Watch."

He then demonstrated what could be achieved through the Limitless Cultivation Technique, rapidly absorbing the Limitless within the room and creating a vortex around himself that pulled in everything like a black hole.

"While the cultivation system is superior when it comes to rapidly increasing your cultivation level, it's actually quite inefficient at replenishing your expended Limitless. That's why those who rely solely on the system—practically everyone in the world—exhaust themselves so easily despite their high cultivation," he elaborated.
"If you want to fight for longer and recover your energy faster, you must learn to cultivate yourself. That is one of the reasons why I am able to fight for so long."
The three ladies stared at him in silence, speechless at the 'secret' behind Yuan's seemingly limitless energy.

Knowing what Yuan was capable of, Supreme General Tian wasn't worried that anything might happen to them.
"They won't be able to do anything to us while we're in the Union. Even if they try to attempt something outside... Let's just say they will regret it."

Yuan returned to his living quarters and spent all of his time studying the Limitless Cultivation Technique.
Meanwhile, the others spent their time mentally preparing themselves for war.

chapters.title: Chapter 2712 Second Assembly(2)
paragraphs: The soldiers of Gaia's Heaven frowned at how many people the other cities had brought, as it made it seem as if they were all anticipating a full-blown war.
Not only were there a lot of people, but they were also the strongest from their respective cities.
Meanwhile, the soldiers from other cities all turned their attention to Yuan, ignoring everyone else, their gazes full of curiosity and worry.
Once all of the seats in the center were occupied, the representative of the Union started calling out each city for accountability.
"Gaia's Heaven."
"Present."
"Spirit City... Ember City... Eastern Dawn... Mirage City... Rising Sun... Cloudpiercer... Jade City... Heavenly Furnace..."
"Present."
When he had accounted for all nine cities, the man announced, "The assembly will now begin."
"You've brought an awful lot of people with you, almost as if you're expecting a war to break out after the assembly," Supreme General Tian said almost immediately, getting straight to the point.
"We're not expecting anything. This is just precaution," said Eastern Dawn's representative.
"What about you, Supreme General Tian? You've also brought more people than last time. What made you bring so many this time?" Mirage City's representative remarked.

Supreme General Tian calmly replied, "I didn't bring as many people last time because I didn't know what to expect. Now that I do, I want more of my people to stay informed about the situation so I won't have to explain everything again once we return."
"In my case, I heard a rather unsavory rumor, so I brought them along for my own safety. Nothing more," Rising Sun's representative said.
"What unsavory rumor?" another representative asked.
"I'm sure you've all heard of it already, so I won't explain it."
The room fell silent for the next several moments before Ember City's representative spoke, "Enough with the chatter. Let's get straight to the point.
He turned to Yuan and asked, "Have you reconsidered our offer from the last assembly, or are you going to remain stubborn?"
Yuan sneered in disdain, "Your offer? Don't make it sound like you asked me nicely when you threatened me."
"How dare you speak to our Commanding General with such a tone?!"
The soldiers behind him exclaimed angrily.
"Shut up. This isn't the place to kiss your commander's ass," Yuan coldly remarked.
The soldiers' faces immediately flushed red as they trembled with anger.
Ember City's representative raised his hand, signaling the soldiers to stand down.
Then, he spoke, "You didn't answer my question."

"No," Yuan calmly replied. "My answer from the last assembly hasn't changed. I will not leave my city and become an independent power. Quite frankly, I don't care about the so-called 'power balance' you're so obsessed with, as there are far more important issues at hand."

Ember City's representative sneered coldly. "By 'important issues,' do you mean Gaia's prophecy—that our world will one day be invaded by otherworldly beings? You know your city is the only one that believes such a fairy tale."
"And yet here you are, using the system created by Gaia," Supreme General Tian sneered.

"That and this are two completely different matters. I have no qualms about using a weapon created by a madman if that weapon proves useful. Whether I choose to believe in the madman's convictions, however, is an entirely different story."
"Let's get back on topic. This assembly isn't about whether Gaia's prophecies are real or not," said Spirit City's representative.

Yuan then said, "Well, I have already given my statement. Now the question is whether you'll go going to war because of your insecurities. Don't forget—I won't defeat the Void Hunter if even a single one of you touches Gaia's Heaven."
"If you can even defeat the Void Hunter, that is." Jade City's representative said.
"He is more than capable of defeating the Void Hunter," Supreme General Tian replied confidently.
"Even after the way the Void Hunter toyed with him during their last fight? Just because it can't kill him doesn't mean he can defeat it."
"I have something I would like to share," Supreme General Tian then said.
He turned to the Union representative and said, "Play it."
The next moment, a screen appeared before each representative, and a certain recording began to play.
Of course, it was showing the recording of Yuan's latest fight with the Void Hunter.
Everyone stared at the screens with wide eyes, some with their mouths agape in shock.
It wasn't just the people from the other cities, either. Even the soldiers of Gaia's Heaven were stunned, as this was their first time seeing the recording as well.
Eventually, they reached the end, where Yuan used Shiva's Eternal Frost and created a landscape of ice.
"What power is that?!"
Several representatives stood up and exclaimed in shock, their eyes bulging out of their sockets.
The recording ended shortly later with the Void Hunter breaking out of the ice and vanishing into thin air.
The chamber fell dead silent, becoming so quiet that even a pin drop from miles away could be heard.
"I-It's fake! It has to be!" Ember City's representative suddenly shouted.
"If you think it's fake, I can replicate that power... on those dogs who were barking at me earlier," Yuan said coldly.
The soldiers who had yelled at Yuan earlier immediately trembled at such words.
"Are you threatening me right now?" The representative questioned with a deep frown on his face.
Yuan quietly shrugged.
Meanwhile, the other representatives fell silent as well, many of them frowning as they stared blankly at the space before them.

Supreme General Tian hadn't shown the recording of Yuan's battle with the Void Hunter merely to demonstrate his progress or prove he could defeat it. He had another purpose—to intimidate the others by showcasing Yuan's unfathomable strength and persuading them not to start a war with Gaia's Heaven, since they would have to face a monster like him.
However, it could just as easily have the opposite effect and convince them to band together against Gaia's Heaven.

"I agree."
"Me too."

Quite frankly, he's a ticking time bomb, and I understand why the others are concerned."
"I agree with General Gu. His power is too dangerous. Even if he's one of our own, there's no telling what might happen in the future, and if he betrays us, that'd spell disaster."
"He has no reason to betray us, but if you keep antagonizing him, I wouldn't blame him for doing so," Mei Feng said coldly.

And we're not antagonizing him. We simply want some reassurance. It's standard procedure, just like how we restrict the cultivation of everyone living within the city."
