"Is that sound coming from the monster?!
How is it even making that noise without a mouth?!" someone exclaimed.
Once the shriek came to an end, the invader moved again, shooting toward Supreme General Tian at blinding speed.
Supreme General Tian tried to evade, but his reaction was just a fraction too slow, and he failed to avoid the attack completely.
"Fuck!" Supreme General Tian cursed out loud as the attack tore through his left arm, his voice in agony.
"Supreme General!" Mei Feng cried out as she attacked the invader, hoping to draw its attention.
However, her attacks had no effect on the invader, so it completely ignored her and continued targeting Supreme General Tian.
Supreme General Tian struggled to keep up, but alas, the invader's speed and prowess were simply too overwhelming.
Before long, he lost his right leg as well.
The other two generals continued attacking the invader relentlessly, but none of their attacks seemed to have any effect.
Seeing this, Ironwoman gritted her teeth and shouted, "You want me, right?!
Then you'll have to catch me first!"
The next moment, she turned around and fled, flying away from the city at full speed.
Sensing her presence rapidly moving away, the invader immediately lost interest in Supreme General Tian and chased after her instead.
"Stop it!
Don't let it capture her!" Supreme General Tian shouted.
"Even if we go after them, there's literally nothing we can do against that thing!" General Gu shook his head, believing it would be pointless to pursue them.
"We should honor her sacrifice and focus on reorganizing the military."
Mei Feng gritted her teeth and clenched her fists in silence.
As much as she hated to admit it, she agreed with General Gu.
It was painfully clear that no one there possessed the strength to stop the invader, and recklessly chasing after it would be no different from throwing their lives away.
"Damn it...
Where the hell is that bastard when we need him the most?!" Supreme General Tian growled in a low voice when he realized that they had no choice but to let the invader chase after Ironwoman.
"He went to deal with the Void Hunter," a familiar voice suddenly resounded.
Supreme General Tian turned toward the voice, his eyes widening in disbelief when he saw Yu Rou.
Although a veil concealed her face, he recognized her identity at a glance.
"Y-You!
What are you doing out here?!
You need to go back!
It's too dangerous for you to be outside right now!" he shouted at her.
"Too dangerous?" Yu Rou muttered, then replied calmly, "There is no longer a place in this world that is safe."
"Gaia..." Mei Feng called out to her.
"What do you mean Yuan went to deal with the Void Hunter?"
"Exactly what it sounds like.
I asked him to eliminate the Void Hunter because we need it gone if we want to cooperate with the other cities.
It would be unrealistic to defend against the invaders from within a single city, and fighting outside isn't an option as long as the Void Hunter continues hunting us."
"Wait... that unfathomable aura we felt right before the invaders appeared... don't tell me that was actually the Void Hunter?!" Supreme General Tian exclaimed upon realizing this.
Until now, he had assumed the aura belonged to the invaders.
Yu Rou approached Supreme General Tian and held her palms before him, pouring her energy into his body and rapidly healing his injuries.
A few seconds later, once he was fully healed, Supreme General Tian said to the others, "I'm going after Ironwoman."
"But—!"
General Gu tried to object, but Supreme General Tian quickly shut him down.
"Your attacks may not work, but that invader was vulnerable to mine.
I'd rather sacrifice my own life than hers.
She's still young, and her talent surpasses even mine.
I refuse to let someone with that much potential die today—at least not before me."
Without hesitation, Supreme General Tian left the scene, soaring in the direction Ironwoman and the invader had gone.
"Why didn't you stop him?" General Gu turned to Yu Rou and asked.
"I have no right to dictate how he decides to retire..." she responded.
"That invader seemed obsessed with Ironwoman.
Do you know why?" Mei Feng then asked.
"It wants to take her to whatever is beyond our sky...
As for the purpose, I don't have the slightest clue," Yu Rou replied with a low sigh.
Meanwhile, the invader had finally caught up to Ironwoman right as they reached the Red Zone.
Realizing the invader had caught up, Ironwoman stopped running and turned to face it.
"I could've never imagined that this would be how I die when I left my family and background behind to go to another city..." Ironwoman sighed as she removed her mask.
"But it's still better than becoming a political tool for my family..."
Without a word, the invader lunged at her.
However, instead of trying to kill her, it moved with the clear intention of capturing her.

chapters.title: Chapter 2723 Fighting the Invader(3)
paragraphs: "Don't you dare touch me with those disgusting hands!" Ironwoman shouted as she fought desperately to keep the invader from getting close, pouring everything she had into the struggle and pushing herself beyond limits she never knew she could reach.
However, no matter what she tried, none of her attacks seemed effective against the invader. Every strike simply bounced off its body without leaving so much as a scratch.
'Damn it! Don't tell me I have no choice but to fight to the bitter end, only to end up captured anyway?!' she cried inwardly.
Soon, her breathing grew noticeably heavier and faster, a clear sign she was running out of energy fast.
'No! I'd rather die than let myself be captured by this monster! Heaven knows what it plans to do with me!'
Left with no other choice, Ironwoman began burning her own life force, prepared to sacrifice herself to fight a little longer rather than be taken alive.
When the invader saw this, it immediately understood her intentions and unleashed its aura, activating a technique for the first time.

The next moment, a dozen silver chains materialized out of thin air and wrapped around Ironwoman, completely restraining her. Not only did they restrict her movements, but they also sealed her cultivation.
'This fucker!'
Ironwoman's mind raced as she desperately searched for a solution, but no matter how hard she thought, she couldn't find any way out of her predicament.
The invader approached Ironwoman and reached for her, but just before it could grab her, a streak of lightning struck it from behind and sent it flying.
"Supreme General?!" Ironwoman exclaimed in surprise when she realized it was him.
"Looks like I made it in time..." Supreme General Tian said, sweat soaking his face.
"W-Why are you—"
He immediately interrupted her and said, "Get out of here and go back to the city while you still can. I'll hold it off for as long as I can."
"What?!" she exclaimed in disbelief.
"There's no time! Hurry!" he roared.
Before Ironwoman could utter another word, Supreme General Tian shot forward and confronted the invader, who had already recovered and was rushing back to them.
Ironwoman wanted to stay and help Supreme General Tian because she knew he wouldn't survive alone. Unfortunately, even if she stayed, the outcome would not change.
Thus, she gritted her teeth and reluctantly left.

One might have expected Supreme General Tian to be just as powerless against the invader as before, but when Yu Rou healed him, she had also shared a portion of her power with him, greatly enhancing his prowess.
Even so, Supreme General Tian was still being overwhelmed by the invader, and the best he could do was delay the inevitable for a few more minutes.
The two clashed relentlessly, and with every exchange, Supreme General Tian would sustain an injury—some minor, others potentially fatal.
In just a few short minutes, Supreme General Tian had lost all four of his limbs, while the rest of his body was riddled with cuts and drenched in blood.
Eventually, Supreme General Tian could no longer move and collapsed onto the ground on his back.
The invader slowly walked up to him and pointed a hand at him, clearly intending to finish him off.
"Looks like I can finally retire..." Supreme General Tian mumbled quietly, gazing at the sky through blurry vision.
He closed his eyes, prepared to accept his fate.
However, the moment he did, a strange sound reached his ears, prompting him to open them again.
When he opened his eyes, the invader standing beside him had completely changed in both shape and size. Even its most distinctive feature—its four arms—was gone.
"You still alive, old man?"
A familiar voice resounded.
"That voice... Captain Yuan?" Supreme General Tian muttered in disbelief.
"Yes, it's me. Sorry for the tardiness. I was dealing with the Void Hunter when they invaded," said Yuan as he poured Limitless into Supreme General Tian's body, sealing all of his wounds.
"I'll bring you back to the city as soon as I deal with that thing."
After confirming that Supreme General Tian's condition had stabilized, Yuan turned his attention toward the invader lying on the ground nearby, its body split cleanly in half at the waist.
Yet, it was clearly still alive.
In fact, Yuan watched as the two severed halves of its body rejoined, and the invader fully recovered within seconds.
The invader slowly got back on its feet, then turned to look at Yuan.
"You don't look like an Eternal. Who's your master?" Yuan asked it.
The invader visibly shook at his question, almost as if it couldn't believe what it'd just heard.
"Is it Deemo? Rashara? Rashira? Saaruk? Ishrak?" Yuan started naming every Eternal he knew.
But the invader didn't react to any of the names.
Yuan shook his head and sighed, "Forget it. There'll be plenty more of you to question later."
Suddenly, Yuan unleashed ten trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence, striking the invader before it could even react.
The very next moment, the invader's body disintegrated into countless tiny fragments before vanishing into thin air like smoke.
Supreme General Tian stared wide-eyed at the spot where the invader had been, disbelief written all over his face.
"There's no way..."
He could hardly comprehend how Yuan had defeated an enemy their entire military had been powerless against with such ease.
After defeating the invader, Yuan returned to Supreme General Tian, lifted him into the air with his cultivation, and flew back toward the city with him.
"What happened to the Void Hunter?" Supreme General Tian asked him as they traveled.
"It's still alive."
After a brief pause, he continued, "But you can forget about it."
"What do you mean?"
"I can't defeat it. It's too powerful," Yuan admitted.
"If the invader had to fight the Void Hunter, not even a million of them could defeat it."
"How can it possibly be that powerful?!" Supreme General Tian exclaimed, unable to believe what he was hearing.
He could barely comprehend the invader's prowess, yet Yuan was telling him that the Void Hunter was at least a million times stronger than that? It was simply too outrageous.

chapters.title: Chapter 2724 Defeating the Invaders
paragraphs: On their way back to Gaia's Heaven, Yuan and Supreme General Tian caught up to Ironwoman, who was so exhausted that she didn't even notice them approaching from behind.
In fact, she was barely conscious by that point, having long since exhausted her energy and resorted to burning her own life force to replenish it.
When Yuan drew close enough, Ironwoman's instincts suddenly kicked in, and she spun around to attack him.
"Whoa!" Yuan cried out in surprise as he casually caught her hand.
"Calm down. It's me," he said softly, gazing at her beautiful face, her beauty undiminished even by her extreme exhaustion.
"Yuan...?" Ironwoman muttered, slowly regaining consciousness as Yuan shared some of his energy with her.
Yet, even after regaining enough energy, Ironwoman continued to stare at Yuan in a daze.
At that moment, a strange sensation stirred within her as she felt a level of relief unlike anything she had ever felt before.
She eventually snapped out of her daze and noticed that Supreme General Tian was also with him.
"S-Supreme General!" she cried out after seeing his condition, looking like a large potato after having lost all of his limbs.
"I'll be fine once Gaia fixes me up. Anyways, let's hurry and return to the city," he said.
"I'll carry you," Yuan said as he wrapped his energy around Ironwoman.

Although she had recovered some of her energy thanks to Yuan, her body was still severely weakened from burning her life force. Such damage was hard to recover from, especially in a world where longevity-increasing pills didn't exist.

When they could finally see the city walls of Gaia's Heaven, Ironwoman suddenly said, "My name is Sun Xinyan, and I originally came from Ember City. In fact, the Ember City representative you met during the assembly is my father."
Ironwoman said, casually dropping an unexpected revelation about her background out of nowhere.

Before Yuan could respond, she continued, "However, I no longer have any relationship with them. They wanted to use me as a political tool, so I left the city and joined Gaia's Heaven, discarding my identity and family."
"Thank you for telling me," Yuan said with a smile.
Sun Xinyan was obviously Sun Rouxi, but Yuan had known that long before he even saw her face. In fact, he knew from the moment they met, recognizing her purely by her voice.
Supreme General Tian was inwardly shocked by Sun Xinyan's revelation, but not simply because she had revealed her identity.
What truly surprised him was that she had willingly gone beyond her background—something she despised and would normally never bring up on her own.
She could have simply said she was originally from Ember City, but instead she chose to reveal more.
Eventually, they returned to the city.
Even before entering, Yuan could already feel the tense atmosphere hanging over Gaia's Heaven.
When they finally arrived at the military base, all of the soldiers had gathered at the Parade Deck, where Mei Feng and General Gu were doing their best to keep everyone together.

However, their encounter with the invader had left many of them traumatized. The fact that even their strongest soldiers had been powerless against a single invader filled them with dread and hopelessness.

"It's hopeless! If we can't even deal with a single invader, how the fuck are we going to survive the rest?! For all we know, there could be thousands of them still waiting to invade us!" one of the soldiers shouted angrily.
"Then what the hell are we supposed to do?! Just roll over and let them kill us without even fighting back?!"
Mei Feng rubbed her eyes and sighed as the soldiers argued back and forth.
Just as she opened her mouth to speak, she noticed three silhouettes approaching them.
"Y-Yuan!" she cried out loud, immediately forgetting what she was about to say.
When the soldiers heard his name, they all turned their heads at once, as if their bodies shared one mind.
Once they landed, Mei Feng immediately asked, "What happened to the invader?!"
"I killed it," Yuan replied nonchalantly, as though he had merely disposed of an insect and accomplished nothing worth mentioning.
Mei Feng swallowed hard before asking nervously, "Was it... difficult?"
Before Yuan could even respond, Supreme General Tian said, "He defeated it in the blink of an eye, treating it as if it were a Void Specter in the Green Zone.
"In the blink of an eye...?" Mei Feng repeated in a mumbling voice, her eyes flickering with hope.
Supreme General Tian looked at the other soldiers and frowned.
"There were far more soldiers before I left. Where are the others?" he inquired.
"That's..."
Mei Feng immediately hesitated to answer, wearing a perplexed expression.
"They killed themselves out of despair," General Gu responded a moment later.
"What?!" Supreme General Tian exclaimed in disbelief.
He turned back to the soldiers, counted how many were present, then compared that number to how many had been there before he left.
'Over a thousand people killed themselves in such a short time?!' he cried inwardly.
He could also tell that many more were still thinking of doing the same, judging by the despair and hopelessness in their eyes.
When the soldiers saw how Supreme General Tian looked at them, many lowered their heads in shame to avoid his gaze.

Yuan suddenly spoke, breaking the silence, "Some of you are probably thinking of killing yourselves right this very moment, and I get it. You think this situation is hopeless—that we're all fated to die. However, hold on to that thought for a little longer. I won't tell you not to kill yourselves, but if you're going to do it, at least wait until I, your last hope, die."
"You..." Supreme General Tian stared at Yuan in disbelief.
Yuan continued, "Now then, although I have taken care of one invader, there are still three more out there."
He looked at Mei Feng and asked, "Do you know where the other three went so I can eradicate them as well?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2725 Saving the Other Cities
paragraphs: Hearing his words, Mei Feng quickly snapped out of her daze and said, "Y-Yes! I do! They have all requested backup, and we were just contemplating whether to go and help them."
"Where?"
"Heavenly Furnace, Eastern Dawn, and Rising Sun!"
"There are teleporters that can take me directly there, right? If I go on foot, it'd be too late."
Although nobody there said a word, almost everyone had the same thought—that it might already be too late to save them.

After all, they'd lasted this long only because Sun Xinyan had sacrificed her life to lure it away, and unless the other cities did the same, it was practically impossible for them to survive this long.
If Gaia's Heaven, considered to have the world's strongest military, was powerless before the invader, what chances would the others have?
"Follow me!"
Realizing that time was of the essence, Mei Feng immediately led Yuan to the teleporter while Supreme General Tian and Sun Xinyan stayed behind.
As they traveled to the teleporter, Mei Feng asked, "Which city do you want to... save first?"
Mei Feng paused briefly mid-sentence when she realized the responsibility she had to place on Yuan.
Since Yuan couldn't save all three cities at once, he could only help them one at a time, but with each visit, the others would have less chance of surviving.
"Which place is more important?" Yuan asked, not a hint of hesitation in his voice.

"Objectively speaking, Heavenly Furnace, since they produce pretty much the majority of this world's weaponry, and if we want to fight back, we'll need weapons. However... I doubt weapons would be of any use against the invaders, so..."
"What about the other two?"
"Eastern Dawn specializes in medicine, and Rising Sun is a jack-of-all-trades."
After a moment of silence, Yuan spoke, "Pick a number from one to three."
"W-What?" Mei Feng turned to look at him with a dumbfounded face.
"One to three," he repeated.
"Uh... two?" she subconsciously answered.
"Rising Sun, it is."
"That's..." Mei Feng wanted to question his method of deciding who might live and who might die, but in the end, she found herself at a loss for words.
After all, it wasn't as though they had the means to save all three of them.
As for Yuan, he didn't have any deep thoughts about his decision and simply decided to let fate decide their fate.

"One more thing..." Mei Feng said as they approached the teleporter. "Teleportation between cities requires the other party to manually accept the teleporting party's request, so there's a chance we might not even be able to teleport to them."
"If that happens, we'll try the others."
Once they arrived at the teleporter, Yuan said, "Come with me. I'll need you to help me use the teleporters in case nobody else is there when I arrive. Don't worry, I can guarantee your safety."
Mei Feng nodded and, without hesitation, entered the teleporter with Yuan.
A few moments after sending in the teleportation request—
"They accepted it! Get ready to be teleported!"
Yuan and Mei Feng vanished from Gaia's Heaven's teleporter and appeared in a massive building somewhere in Rising Sun.
To their surprise, the place was absolutely crowded with people—people who wanted to escape the city to another one.
But because the teleporter required so much energy to operate, only the wealthy and powerful could even hope to use it.
"W-Why are there only two of you?!" The teleporter's operator cried out in disbelief after seeing that only two people had shown up.
When he saw a teleportation request from Gaia's Heaven, he immediately assumed it was reinforcement, so he expected far more than just two individuals.
Yuan didn't even bother to respond and swiftly wasted no time sweeping the entire city with divine sense to find the invader's position.
Once he located the invader's position, Yuan said, "I'll be right back."
Without waiting for Mei Feng's response, Yuan used Void Manipulation and disappeared into thin air.
A few seconds later, Yuan emerged from the void directly in front of the invader.
"Yo."
Before the invader—who looked similar to the one Yuan had already killed—could even process what was happening, Yuan unleashed his power and vaporized it in the blink of an eye.
"What the hell just happened?!"
The soldiers who had been struggling against the invader stared in shock and disbelief at the unexpected turn of events.
But before any of them could even utter a word, Yuan entered the void again and returned to Mei Feng's side.
"Y-You're back already?" Mei Feng muttered in a daze, as it hadn't even been ten seconds since Yuan left.
"One or two?" Yuan suddenly asked.
"One."
Mei Feng hastily responded without thinking.

chapters.title: Chapter 2726 Defeating the Last Invader
paragraphs: After defeating the third invader, Yuan returned to the teleportation device and said to the operator, "The invader is dead. Send us to Eastern Dawn immediately."
"H-Huh? What did you say? The invader is—"
"Stop yapping and hurry up with the damn teleporter! Another city still needs to be saved! If we're late, I'll blame you for it and have you bear responsibility!" Mei Feng raised her voice this time.
The operator froze for a good second, then snapped out of it and promptly sent the teleportation request to Eastern Dawn, silently hoping that they'd respond.
One second... two seconds... five seconds...

Every second felt like an hour to the operator, whose face and back were drenched in sweat. His eyes occasionally drifted toward Mei Feng before he hastily looked away, repeating it several times until he finally saw a response.
"A-Accepted! I'll teleport you immediately!" The operator exclaimed as he activated the teleporter.
The next moment, Yuan and Mei Feng were teleported out of Heavenly Furnace and appeared inside an empty building with its entire roof missing.
It was clearly not part of the structure's original design. Rather, it looked as though something enormous had simply swatted away the entire upper half of the building.
"W-What?! Two people?!" The operator, the only person present, exclaimed in disbelief.
Yuan ignored him and quickly swept his divine sense across the city.
At a glance, he could tell more than half of it had been destroyed, and much of what remained was engulfed in a sea of flames.
However, a bizarre scene drew his attention almost instantly.

Hovering above the city was a massive black sphere, and upon closer inspection, he realized it was made entirely of humans. Tens of millions had been gathered and captured, their bodies closely packed together to form an enormous sphere.
"This guy... how unbelievably greedy..." The invader's greed left Yuan almost speechless.
After confirming that the humans gathered were still alive, Yuan swiftly used Void Manipulation, teleporting right next to the invader.
The invader, too preoccupied with gathering the remaining humans, noticed Yuan far too late.
Before it could even react, it was sent plummeting from the sky and slammed face-first into the ground.

One might have expected Yuan to kill it immediately, just as he had done with the previous three. However, since this was the last of the four invaders to enter their world, he was no longer pressed for time and could finally interrogate one properly.
"Who's your master? The Eternal that sent you to this world."
Yuan could feel the invader within his grasp physically trembling at his question.
"Answer me," Yuan coldly demanded as he crushed the invader's neck, knowing full well such an injury was insignificant to them.
When the invader refused to answer, Yuan continued beating it, gradually increasing the brutality of his attacks.
Unfortunately, no matter what he did, the invader seemed unwilling to respond.
'Maybe they really are unable to speak?' Yuan wondered inwardly.
He turned his head to look at the people who were still suspended in the air and sighed, "Forget it."
The next moment, Yuan used his affinity and instantly killed the invader, vaporizing its body until not even a single cell of it remained.

Once the invader was killed, the people in the air began dropping from the sky like flies. Although they were all cultivators and could fly, many of them were still in shock and couldn't think properly.
Seeing this, Yuan helped them land safely by slowing their fall with his own energy.
However, moments later, before everyone could even reach the ground, the entire world began to tremble.
RUMBLE!
Suddenly, the clouds vanished as though swept away by a powerful gust of wind, revealing a clear sky for the first time.
This phenomenon wasn't limited to Yuan's location—it occurred across the entire world, allowing everyone to clearly see the countless flickering stars above.

At that moment, practically everyone had their heads tilted toward the clear sky. Yet their attention wasn't drawn to the countless flickering stars scattered across the darkness, but to something else entirely.
"W-What the fuck is that?!"
"Ahhhh!"
Terror, shock, bewilderment—all sorts of emotions swept through countless people as they stared at the massive face looming in the sky, gazing down at them like a god.
The hairless head was unfathomably massive, appearing even larger than their entire world.
Its uncanny face was frozen in a blank, statue-like expression. Although its features were distinctly human, its eyes were completely white, devoid of irises or pupils.
Although it was nearly impossible to tell where it was looking, Yuan felt an unsettling certainty that its gaze was fixed directly on him.
However, more importantly, he didn't recognize the face. He thought the Eternal behind the invasion would be someone he already knew, even expecting it to be Deemo, but that was not the case.
"Who are you?" Yuan loudly asked, staring back at the Eternal with a calm yet cold gaze.
Although the Eternal did not respond, it narrowed its gaze.
Then, after a moment of silence, it withdrew its head and vanished into the starry sky as if it had never existed.
"I-Is that it? Is the invasion over?" someone wondered aloud.

But almost immediately after those words were uttered, the people on Earth noticed the stars were growing bigger. Eventually, they realized that the majority of tiny dots scattered across the sky weren't stars at all, but the very same entities that had just invaded their world.
"My lord... There are thousands of them..."
Countless people fell to their knees after this realization, their eyes devoid of hope.
Soon, the invaders began attacking the barrier, sending thousands of small ripples across the sky, like raindrops disturbing the surface of a vast ocean.
"It's over... It's over for us!"
The people started screaming and crying.
Yuan looked at the chaos unfolding around him and shook his head inwardly.

Even if he wanted to intervene, there was nothing he could do or say that would calm everyone down. In the end, he could only let the panic run its course and wait for them to settle down on their own.

chapters.title: Chapter 2727 The Eternal's Name
paragraphs: While everyone around him cried in despair, Yuan quietly returned to Mei Feng, who stood frozen like a statue, staring at the sky with a perplexed expression.
As Yuan approached, Mei Feng asked in a low but clear voice without shifting her gaze from the sky, "Do you think you'll be able to defeat all of them?"
"...By yourself," she added a split second later.
Yuan stood beside her and looked up at the sky as well.
"Sorry, but I cannot make any promises."
Although he was confident he could defeat all the invaders himself, he wasn't sure he could handle the Eternal behind them.

Mei Feng shook her head and replied in a soft voice, "No, you don't have anything to apologize for. If anything, I... this world should be apologizing to you for making you bear the responsibility of saving humanity."

"If all of the invaders are on the same level as the ones I've already defeated, I can certainly defeat all of them with ease. Unfortunately, the issue lies with their master—the Eternal that is commanding them."
"That bald head that's larger than our entire world, huh?" Mei Feng sighed.

After a brief moment of silence, she said, "If I had known this was how our lives and this world would end, I wouldn't have joined the military and just spent the rest of my life as a civilian and enjoyed life as an ordinary individual. I haven't even gotten to experience love yet. What a pity."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at her words and turned to look at her, puzzled.
"That's not something I'd expect to hear from a mother."
Mei Feng smiled and said, "Just because I have a daughter doesn't mean I've experienced love."
"Arranged marriage, huh?" Yuan muttered.
"What are you talking about?" Mei Feng finally stopped looking at the sky and turned to face him.
"I'm not married, nor have I ever been."
"Huh? Then what about the father?"
"He doesn't exist, either."
Yuan's eyes widened.
"Are you telling me that Mei Xiaoyun was adopted?"
"No, she definitely came from my womb."
"Then how...?

"Since you're from another world, you probably don't know this, but we have technology that allows women to give birth without needing a man. Xiaoyun was created entirely from my genes. It wouldn't be wrong to call her a clone of me, though that isn't entirely accurate either, since there are still some differences between us," she revealed, dropping a shocking bombshell.
Yuan's jaw dropped at her words.
"W-Why?"

"Because we're short on people. Our population has been declining for decades, and with the Void Specters growing stronger over time, the situation has only gotten worse. That said, we're not required to do it. It's all optional."
"Can I ask why you decided to do it?"
"I ask myself that question all the time, and even now, I still wonder why I did such a thing. Honestly, it doesn't matter anymore, and it's not like I regret it."
"Does Mei Xiaoyun know this?"
"Of course. I have no reason to keep it a secret from her, and she would've found out herself eventually."
Since it was common, even normal, in their world, keeping it a secret would do more harm than good.
After a moment of silence, Mei Feng spoke, "Hey, want to be my lover?"
"What?" Yuan's eyes widened at her question.
"Or would you rather be with my daughter?"
Yuan was speechless.
But when Yuan finally opened his mouth to speak, Mei Feng interrupted, "I'm joking. Let's return to our city now."
Mei Feng turned to the teleporter, but the operator was nowhere to be seen.

Mei Feng shook her head and operated the teleporter herself, entering a direct teleportation code for Gaia's Heaven so they could return without requiring approval, since no one was there to operate the other side.
Once they returned to Gaia's Heaven, they went to the Parade Deck, and sure enough, everyone was still there, most of them staring at the sky with despair in their eyes.

"It hasn't even been ten minutes since you left. How did it go with the other invaders? Did you manage to save any of the other cities?" Supreme General Tian asked, already expecting the worst because of how quickly they'd returned.
Mei Feng then said, "Although I don't know the condition of each city due to how fast we traveled between each city, Yuan took care of the remaining invaders."
"They should be fine," said Yuan. "Eastern Dawn had the worst damage, but their people are safe because the invader had gathered all of them in one place without harming them."
"What's the plan now?" Yuan then asked.
Supreme General Tian fell silent.
He slowly turned his gaze to the sky, where thousands of invaders gathered just outside the barrier.
"There's even more of them now..." he sighed.

"Unfortunately, I don't know what we can do—if there's even anything we can do about this situation. Unless you are able to defeat all of the invaders by yourself, humanity and this world are doomed."
"I'll do what I can, but I won't make any promises."
Supreme General Tian wore a bitter expression as he realized that he was placing the weight of the entire world on Yuan's shoulders alone.
"Yuan."
A familiar voice suddenly called out.
When Yuan turned, he saw Yu Rou standing not too far away, wearing a black veil.
"I need a moment of your time."
Yuan nodded and followed Yu Rou to a quieter place.
"What's up?" Yuan asked when Yu Rou finally stopped.
She turned around to face him and said, "It has spoken to me."
Yuan raised an eyebrow.
"The Eternal behind you?"
She nodded.
"And I asked for its name."
"Did it tell you?"
Yu Rou remained silent for a few seconds before slowly nodding her head.
"Oh?" Yuan muttered, sounding pleasantly surprised.
"What is their name?"
Yu Rou took a deep breath through her nose before opening her mouth, "Its name is—"

chapters.title: Chapter 2728 More Time
paragraphs: "Its name is—" Yu Rou revealed the Eternal's name.
However, Yuan looked puzzled afterward.
"Sorry, but can you say that again?"
"Its name is—"
Yu Rou repeated the name, but to Yuan it sounded like gibberish, reminding him of the first time he'd heard Xiao Hua recite Heaven's Secret Art to him.
'Am I unable to hear its name for whatever reason, or is it spoken in a language that I don't understand?' he wondered inwardly.
"What's wrong?" Yu Rou eventually asked him.
Yuan told her the truth—that he couldn't understand the name.
"You can't comprehend it? I'm not speaking in another language, either," Yu Rou revealed, confirming Yuan's initial suspicion.
"I guess I am not permitted to learn its name," Yuan sighed aloud.
"Does knowing its name really matter?" Yu Rou then asked. "Will it help us with the invaders?"
"Well... it's important information, but it probably won't help our situation. Anyways, can you write its name down for me? I want to see if that would allow me to see it."
Yu Rou nodded, pointed a finger at the ground, and wrote words on it with Limitless.
Yuan stared at the ground, dumbfounded.
"Well? Can you read it?" Yu Rou asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 2729 Revisiting Heavenly White Valley(End of Gaia's Heaven Arc)
paragraphs: "Mu Xuelian? What are you doing here? No... where am I?" Yuan muttered, his memories feeling somewhat hazy.
"You... don't remember?" Mu Xuelian raised an eyebrow at him.
Yuan fell silent for a moment as his memories slowly cleared.
"Ah... I see... I have returned to the Nine Heavens..."
"What are you talking about? You never left," Mu Xuelian said after hearing his mumbling.
Yuan wasn't surprised by her words, since he already knew he'd traveled to Gaia's Heaven only with his soul, not his physical body.
"How long have I been asleep?" Yuan then asked.
"Three days."
"T-Three days?!" Yuan exclaimed in shock.

He had experienced several years in the other world, yet only three days had passed in the Nine Heavens. The difference in the flow of time between the two worlds was far greater than he had expected.
This realization immediately worried Yuan, especially since the other world was already on the verge of a full-scale invasion.
Although the Eternal gave them more time by strengthening the barrier, it wasn't a permanent solution.
However, even if Yuan wanted to return to the other world, he wasn't sure how.
He looked around the chamber, but it was completely empty.
'Not even a clue, huh?' Yuan sighed inwardly.
"So, what did you acquire in here?" Mu Xuelian asked.
"What do you mean?" When Yuan turned to look at her, he realized that Shiva had taken her place and was the one who had just spoken.
"Are you really going to act dumb?"
Shiva flipped her right palm, conjuring an ice mirror before Yuan and said, "Take a look at yourself."
Yuan looked into the mirror, and his eyes widened slightly. Although most of the otherworldly changes he had undergone in Gaia's Heaven had reverted, they hadn't disappeared completely.
A noticeable strand of white hair remained among his otherwise black hair, while his right eye still shimmered with a myriad of colors.
"Not only that, but your aura..." Shiva narrowed her eyes before asking in a somewhat nervous tone, "How much Eternal Essence can you wield right now?"
Although she couldn't tell exactly how much stronger Yuan had become, the natural presence he exuded made it obvious that his strength had increased drastically.
'For his aura to have grown so much in such a short time... whatever he acquired in this place is definitely extraordinary!' Shiva thought to herself.
"I didn't acquire anything in here," Yuan said, not bothering to reveal the truth to her.
"Is that so?" Shiva didn't press him further, knowing he still didn't fully trust her.
"In any case, are we done here?" she then asked.
"Yes."
Yuan stretched his body a bit before leaving the chamber.
On his way out, Yuan examined his body and its condition.
'As I thought, the cultivation I gained in the other world didn't transfer to this body... However, my Eternal Essence is a different story.'

Although his cultivation remained at the God Ascension realm, all of the Eternal Essence he had accumulated in the other world had carried over, meaning he still possessed ten trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence.

While it was a pity that his cultivation hadn't increased, it hardly mattered in the grand scheme of things. What truly mattered was the growth of his Eternal Essence, since ordinary cultivation had little effect against Eternals.
Of course, Gaia's System also remained.
Once they returned to the surface, Mu Xuelian asked, "Where are we going now?"
"I'm going to complete my physique, but first..."
Yuan turned to look in the direction of the Heavenly White Valley and mumbled, "Since I'm already here, I might as well check up on them."
Some time later, Yuan arrived at the Heavenly White Valley. However, upon seeing the state it was in, he could hardly comprehend what lay before his eyes.

"What the fuck happened here?" Yuan couldn't help but curse aloud as he stared at the scorched land before him, as if a massive wildfire had recently swept through and consumed everything in its path.
Not only had the entire Heavenly White Valley been destroyed, but there wasn't a single sign of life remaining.
After snapping out of his daze, Yuan searched the area for any clues that might explain what had happened.
However, with the entire place reduced to ruins, he had little hope of finding anything useful.
Eventually, Yuan reached the main residential area where the Clan Leader and elders had lived, only to find it, too, had been completely destroyed.
The first person who came to Yuan's mind upon seeing the devastation was a certain little girl.
'What in heaven's name happened here? Bai Sulan... I hope nothing happened to her.'
After confirming nothing remained, Yuan made his way to the last place left—the Heavenly White Tiger's Ancestral Altar.
Upon arriving, Yuan immediately noticed that the gates were wide open.

Although their ancestor's blood essence was no longer there, the Heavenly White Tiger Clan had chosen to continue treating the place as sacred, guarding it just as strictly as before. Under normal circumstances, the gates should never have been left open like this.
Yuan took a step toward the entrance and frowned when a powerful stench suddenly assaulted his nose—the unmistakable smell of death.
Ignoring the stench, Yuan walked through the entrance, followed a short passage, and arrived at an enclosed chamber.
The frown Yuan had worn since entering the chamber deepened when he saw the horrifying scene before him—one gruesome enough to disturb even the most cold-hearted killer.
Thousands of corpses were piled throughout the chamber, their bodies submerged in a pool of dried blood.
Although these corpses were burned beyond recognition, Yuan immediately knew they were the Heavenly White Tigers that had once lived there.
Yuan clenched his fists, his eyes flickering with anger.
Mu Xuelian, who was standing beside him, closed her eyes and sighed inwardly.
'Judging by the state of the corpses and the dried blood... this didn't happen recently,' Yuan thought.
A few minutes later, Yuan turned around and left.

chapters.title: Chapter 2730 Location of the Boundless Spirit Dew
paragraphs: After leaving the Heavenly White Tiger's Altar, Yuan stood at the entrance, tilting his head up to the sky.
"Is this karma?" he muttered quietly.
He couldn't help but wonder if this was karma finally catching up to the Heavenly White Tiger Clan for all the atrocities they had committed before he forced them to change.
If it weren't for his connection to their ancestor, his first visit would have likely ended in a massacre.
Some time later, Yuan turned toward the Heavenly White Tiger's Altar, his aura suddenly rising tremendously.
Woosh!
The next moment, he unleashed his Supreme Sword Aura on the entire mountain, carving it apart until nothing remained and leaving a large crater.
"Do you have a clue what happened here?" Mu Xuelian inquired out of curiosity.
"No, not in the slightest. But I will find the culprit, and I will make them pay."
However, he wasn't doing this to avenge the Heavenly White Tiger Clan. His concern was mostly for a single individual—Bai Sulan.
Of course, he had no way of knowing whether she was among the corpses. But until he could confirm she was alive, he had no choice but to assume the worst.
"What now?" Mu Xuelian then asked.
"I'll ask around to see if anyone knows anything."
They left Heavenly White Valley shortly after, heading to the nearest city.
Immediately upon arrival, Yuan asked around if anyone knew anything about the Heavenly White Tiger Clan's destruction.
"What happened to the Heavenly White Tiger Clan? Did something happen to them?"
"Heavenly White Tiger Clan? They're an incredibly secluded place, so nobody really pays attention to them."

To Yuan's surprise, none of the people he questioned seemed to know that anything had happened to the Heavenly White Tiger Clan, much less that their valley had been destroyed and its inhabitants slaughtered.
Due to the Heavenly White Tiger Clan's reputation, very few people actually dare to approach their territory, and those who do only stay on the outskirts.

Although the Heavenly White Tiger Clan had changed its ways, repairing a damaged reputation typically required a tremendous amount of time—sometimes even several generations—before word of that change spread throughout the rest of the world.
After speaking with over a hundred people, including information brokers, Yuan still learned nothing about the situation, gave up, and left.
'Let's focus on completing my physique first.'
With that in mind, Yuan pondered how he should proceed.
To complete the Eternal Constitution, he needed the Golden Immortal Physique, the Harmonic Spirit Constitution, and the Myriad Impervious Physique.
Since he already possessed the Golden Immortal Physique, he only needed the other two.

'In order to attain the other two physiques, I need certain treasures. I already have most of what's required for the Harmonic Spirit Constitution, leaving only the Boundless Spirit Dew. As for the Myriad Impervious Physique, I already possess the necessary immunities and only need the Iridescent Harmony Fruit...' Yuan recalled what Shiva told him.
Since he needed only one treasure for each physique, Yuan pondered which one to chase first.
In the end, he decided to go after whichever was easier to get.
Some time later, Yuan visited an information broker again, but this time, he wanted information on the treasures he needed.
"I need information on two treasures. The Boundless Spirit Dew and the Iridescent Harmony Fruit."
The information broker raised an eyebrow at the names.
After a moment of silence, he spoke, "Sorry, but I only recognize the Boundless Spirit Dew, and I'd only learned of it very recently."
"What can you tell me about it?"
"I can tell you where to acquire it."
"How much?"
The information broker pondered for a moment before giving Yuan a price.
"Ten thousand spirit stones," he said.
"That's a lot cheaper than I expected," Yuan remarked.
After all, the Boundless Spirit Dew should have been a priceless treasure, so for information regarding its location to cost only a measly few thousand spirit stones seemed far too suspicious.
Sensing Yuan's doubt, the information broker swiftly said, "If you think I am trying to scam you, that isn't the case. As for why it's so cheap... you'll know once you pay."
"Let's hear it."

Yuan placed ten thousand spirit stones on the table. Since it wasn't much to him, he wasn't worried about losing it. And if the information turned out to be false, he could simply take the money back.

After confirming the payment, the information broker revealed, "The Boundless Spirit Dew will be offered as a reward in an upcoming event hosted by the Gates of Heaven in the Ninth Heaven. The reason this information is so cheap is that it's already widely known."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at this information.
'Gates of Heaven? That's Senior Bai's sect,' he thought.
"What sort of event?" he asked a moment later.
"It's a race that spans the entirety of the Ninth Heaven."
"A race?" Yuan muttered, sounding somewhat taken aback.
"It's no ordinary race. It will take place throughout the starry sky, with various trials scattered along the course to challenge the participants."
"And when does this event start?"
"Half a year."
"I see. Thanks."
After leaving, Yuan said to Mu Xuelian, "Looks like we'll be heading to the Ninth Heaven now."
However, Yuan suddenly realized he hadn't yet passed the unique trial, as it had been interrupted midway.
'I was thrown into the Demonic Realm after that, and once I finally made it out, I returned to the Seventh Heaven, where I am now...' he sighed inwardly.

Although he wanted to continue the trial, the original Stairway to Heaven was still hidden, replaced by the new one, which lacked the ability to provide the unique trial for him, something only the original one could do.
'Since I can't continue the trial, I might as well just head to the Ninth Heaven first and deal with it at a later time,' Yuan thought.
After all, although he hadn't finished the unique trial, he'd finished the required trials and met the requirements to enter the Ninth Heaven.
He left the city shortly later and traveled to the Nameless Stairway with Mu Xuelian.
